title.zh: 卷二 魏本紀第二: 世祖太武帝 恭宗景穆帝 高宗文成帝 顯祖獻文帝
title.en: Volume 2 Wei Annals 2: Emperor Gaozu Taiwu, Emperor Gongzong Jingmu, Emperor Gaozong Wencheng, Emperor Xianzu Xianwen
title.raw: 卷二 魏本紀第二: 世祖太武帝 恭宗景穆帝 高宗文成帝 顯祖獻文帝 Volume 2 Wei Annals 2: Emperor Gaozu Taiwu, Emperor Gongzong Jingmu, Emperor Gaozong Wencheng, Emperor Xianzu Xianwen

sentences.zh: 世祖太武皇帝諱燾，明元皇帝之長子也。

translations.literal: Shizu Emperor Taiwu; taboo name Tao; eldest son of Emperor Mingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taiwu the Grand Ancestor, taboo name Tao, was the eldest son of Emperor Mingyuan.

sentences.zh: 母曰杜貴嬪。

translations.literal: His mother was Lady Du the Esteemed Consort.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Consort Du Gui.

sentences.zh: 天賜五年，生於東宮。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianci he was born in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tianci he was born in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 體貌瑰異，道武奇之，曰：「成吾業者必此兒也。

translations.literal: His form and countenance were rare and extraordinary; Emperor Daowu marveled at him and said, "He who completes my enterprise must be this boy.
translations.idiomatic: His bearing was singular and splendid; Emperor Daowu marveled at him, saying, "This boy alone will finish what I began.

sentences.zh: 」泰常七年四月，封太平王。

translations.literal: " In the fourth month of the seventh year of Taichang he was enfeoffed as Prince of Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fourth month of Taichang year seven he received the title Prince of Taiping.

sentences.zh: 五月，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 及明元帝疾，命帝總攝百揆。

translations.literal: When Emperor Mingyuan fell ill, he ordered the Emperor to take overall charge of all government affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Mingyuan fell ill, he put the heir in charge of the whole administration.

sentences.zh: 帝聰明大度，意豁如也。

translations.literal: The Emperor was intelligent and magnanimous, his mind broad and open.
translations.idiomatic: He was quick-witted and large-hearted, his thoughts clear and unconfined.

sentences.zh: 八年十一月己巳，明元帝崩，壬申，太子即皇帝位，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the eighth year, on the day jisi, Emperor Mingyuan died; on the day renshen the crown prince took the imperial throne and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of year eight, on jisi day Mingyuan died; on renshen day the crown prince ascended the throne and pardoned the empire.

sentences.zh: 十二月，追尊皇妣為密皇太后。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he posthumously honored his imperial mother as Empress Dowager Mi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he raised his birth mother to Empress Dowager Mi.

sentences.zh: 進司徒長孫嵩爵為北平王；

translations.literal: He advanced Minister of Works Changle Fu Sun Yuan's noble rank to Prince of Beiping;
translations.idiomatic: He promoted Minister of Works Sun Yuan, Prince of Beiping;

sentences.zh: 司空奚斤為宜城王；

translations.literal: Minister of Works Xi Jin to Prince of Yicheng;
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Xi Jin to Prince of Yicheng;

sentences.zh: 藍田公長孫翰為平陽王。

translations.literal: Duke of Lantian Changle Fu Sun Han to Prince of Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Lantian Sun Han to Prince of Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 其餘普增爵位各有差。

translations.literal: The rest received general advancement of noble rank, each according to his measure.
translations.idiomatic: All others had their ranks raised in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 於是除禁錮，釋嫌疑，開倉庫，振窮乏。

translations.literal: Thereupon he lifted prohibitions and confinements, released those held under suspicion, opened the granaries, and relieved the destitute.
translations.idiomatic: He ended detention and suspicion, opened the storehouses, and succored the poor.

sentences.zh: 河南流人相率內屬者甚眾。

translations.literal: Refugees south of the Yellow River came over in great numbers in succession.
translations.idiomatic: South-of-the-River exiles flocked inward in droves.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月己卯，車駕至自北伐。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year, on the day jimao of the first month, the imperial carriage returned from the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year two, on jimao of the first month, the emperor came back from the northern expedition.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，尊保母竇氏曰保太后。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen of the third month he honored his foster mother, the Dou clan, as Empress Dowager Bao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the third month he raised his nurse, Lady Dou, to Empress Dowager Bao.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以北平王長孫嵩為太尉，平陽王長孫翰為司徒，宜城王奚斤為司空。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi he appointed Prince of Beiping Changle Fu Sun Yuan Grand Commandant, Prince of Pingyang Changle Fu Sun Han Minister over the Masses, and Prince of Yicheng Xi Jin Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he named Sun Yuan of Beiping Grand Commandant, Sun Han of Pingyang Minister over the Masses, and Xi Jin of Yicheng Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚申，營故東宮為萬壽宮，起永安、安樂二殿、臨望觀、九華堂。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen he turned the former Eastern Palace into the Palace of Long Life and raised the Yong'an and Anle Halls, the Linwang View, and the Jiuhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he made the old Eastern Palace the Palace of Long Life and built the Yong'an and Anle halls, the Linwang belvedere, and the Jiuhua hall.

sentences.zh: 初造新字千餘。

translations.literal: For the first time he devised more than a thousand new characters.
translations.idiomatic: He first created more than a thousand new written characters.

sentences.zh: 夏四月詔龍驤將軍步堆使宋。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer an edict ordered Dragon Cavalry General Bu Dui to go as envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month he sent Dragon Cavalry General Bu Dui on embassy to Song.

sentences.zh: 五月，詔天下十家發大牛一頭運粟塞上。

translations.literal: In the fifth month an edict ordered every ten households throughout the realm to furnish one great ox to haul grain to the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he ordered every ten households to send one draft ox to haul grain to the border.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，赫連屈丐死。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn Helian Qubu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn Helian Qubu died.

sentences.zh: 九月，永安、安樂二殿成，丁卯，大饗以落之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Yong'an and Anle Halls were completed; on the day dingmao he held a great feast to mark their completion.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Yong'an and Anle halls were finished; on dingmao he held a grand banquet to dedicate them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，車駕北伐，東西五道並出。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guimao, the imperial carriage marched north to campaign, five routes setting out east and west together.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the tenth winter month the emperor marched north on campaign, five columns advancing east and west at once.

sentences.zh: 平陽王長孫翰等絕漠追寇，蠕蠕北走。

translations.literal: Prince of Pingyang Changle Fu Sun Han and others crossed the desert in pursuit of the enemy; the Rouran fled north.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Han of Pingyang and others chased the foe beyond the desert; the Rouran broke north.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月壬申，車駕至自北伐。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, on the day renshen of the first month, the imperial carriage returned from the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year three, on renshen of the first month, the emperor returned from the northern expedition.

sentences.zh: 乞伏熾盤遣使朝貢，請討赫連昌。

translations.literal: Qifu Chipo sent envoys to present tribute and asked permission to attack Helian Chang.
translations.idiomatic: Qifu Chipo sent tribute and asked leave to strike Helian Chang.

sentences.zh: 二月，起太學於城東，祀孔子，以顏回配。

translations.literal: In the second month he founded the Imperial Academy east of the city, sacrificed to Confucius, and paired Yan Hui in the rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he founded the Imperial Academy east of the capital, sacrificed to Confucius, and paired Yan Hui at the altar.

sentences.zh: 夏五月辛卯，進中山公纂爵為王，復南安公素先爵常山王。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao of the fifth month of summer he advanced Duke of Zhongshan Zuan's noble rank to prince and restored Duke of Nan'an Su Xian to Prince of Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the fifth summer month he raised Duke Zuan of Zhongshan to princely rank and restored Su Xian of Nan'an as Prince of Changshan.

sentences.zh: 六月，幸雲中舊宮，謁陵廟，西至五原，田於陰山，東至和兜山。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he visited the old palace at Yunzhong, paid homage at the imperial tombs, went west to Wuyuan, hunted on Yinshan, and went east to Mount Hedou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he visited the old palace at Yunzhong, worshipped at the tombs, went west to Wuyuan, hunted on Yinshan, and east to Mount Hedou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，築馬射臺於長川，帝親登臺走馬。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he built a horse-archery platform on the Long River; the Emperor himself mounted the platform and galloped.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month he built a mounted archery terrace on the Long River and rode there himself.

sentences.zh: 王公諸國君長馳射中者，賜金錦繒絮各有差。

translations.literal: Princes, dukes, and the chieftains of the various states who hit the mark in the galloping shoot received gold, brocade, and silk wadding, each according to his measure.
translations.idiomatic: Princes, lords, and tribal chiefs who scored in the galloping shoot won gold, brocade, and silk in graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 八月，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 宋人來聘。

translations.literal: Men of Song came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys from Song arrived on a courtesy visit.

sentences.zh: 帝以赫連屈丐死，諸子相攻，冬十月丁巳，車駕西伐，幸雲中，臨君子津。

translations.literal: Because Helian Qubu had died and his sons were attacking one another, on the day dingsi of the tenth month of winter the imperial carriage marched west to campaign, visited Yunzhong, and came to Junzi Ford.
translations.idiomatic: When Qubu died and his sons turned on each other, on dingsi in the tenth winter month the emperor marched west, stopped at Yunzhong, and reached Junzi Ford.

sentences.zh: 會天暴寒，數日冰合。

translations.literal: It happened that heaven turned violently cold; within days the ice closed.
translations.idiomatic: A sudden bitter freeze came; within days the river froze solid.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，率輕騎襲赫連昌。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin of the eleventh month he led light cavalry in a surprise strike on Helian Chang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the eleventh month he led light horse in a surprise raid on Helian Chang.

sentences.zh: 壬午，徙萬餘家而還。

translations.literal: On the day renwu he moved more than ten thousand households and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he relocated more than ten thousand households and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 至祚山，班虜獲以賜將士各有差。

translations.literal: At Mount Zuo he distributed captives and booty to the officers and soldiers, each according to his measure.
translations.idiomatic: At Mount Zuo he divided captives and spoils among the troops in graded shares.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔奚斤西據長安。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month an edict ordered Xi Jin to seize and hold Chang'an in the west.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he ordered Xi Jin to occupy Chang'an in the west.

sentences.zh: 秦、隴氐羌皆叛昌詣斤降。

translations.literal: The Di and Qiang of Qin and Long all rebelled against Chang and came to Xi Jin to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Di and Qiang of Qin and Long all renounced Chang and surrendered to Xi Jin.

sentences.zh: 武都王楊玄及沮渠蒙遜等使使內附。

translations.literal: King of Wudu Yang Xuan and Juqu Mengxun and others sent envoys to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xuan of Wudu and Juqu Mengxun and others sent envoys to tender allegiance.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙酉，車駕至自西伐，賜留臺文武各有差。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, on the day yiyou of the first month, the imperial carriage returned from the western campaign and bestowed rewards on the civil and military officials who had remained at the capital, each according to his measure.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year four, on yiyou of the first month, the emperor returned from the western campaign and rewarded the capital officials in graded gifts.

sentences.zh: 從人在道多死，到者裁十六七。

translations.literal: Many of those who had followed him on the road died; of those who arrived, barely one or two in ten survived.
translations.idiomatic: Many who marched with him died on the road; barely a tenth of the host reached home.

sentences.zh: 己亥，行幸幽州。

translations.literal: On the day jihai he traveled in state to You province.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he went in state to You province.

sentences.zh: 赫連昌遣其弟定向長安。

translations.literal: Helian Chang sent his younger brother Ding toward Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Helian Chang sent his brother Ding against Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之，遣就陰山伐木造攻具。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard of it, he sent men to Yinshan to fell timber and build siege engines.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing this, he sent men to Yinshan to cut timber for siege machines.

sentences.zh: 二月，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the second month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，詔執金吾桓貸造橋於君子津。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu of the third month an edict ordered Commandant of the Imperial Insignia Huan Dai to build a bridge at Junzi Ford.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the third month he ordered Commandant Huan Dai to bridge Junzi Ford.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，廣平王連薨。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou Prince of Guangping Lian died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Prince Lian of Guangping died.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，詔員外散騎常侍步堆使於宋。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei of the fourth month of summer an edict ordered Supernumerary Palace Attendant Bu Dui to go as envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the fourth summer month he sent Palace Attendant Bu Dui on embassy to Song.

sentences.zh: 五月，車駕西討赫連昌，次拔鄰山。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the imperial carriage marched west to attack Helian Chang and halted at Bolin Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the emperor marched west against Helian Chang and camped at Bolin Mountain.

sentences.zh: 築城舍輜重，以輕騎三萬先行。

translations.literal: He walled a city, left the baggage train, and sent thirty thousand light cavalry ahead.
translations.idiomatic: He fortified a camp, left the train, and pushed thirty thousand light horse forward.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，至黑水。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu he reached the Black River.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he reached the Black River.

sentences.zh: 帝親祈天，告祖宗之靈而誓眾。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally prayed to Heaven, addressed the spirits of the ancestors, and swore the host.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor prayed to Heaven in person, invoked the ancestral spirits, and bound the army with an oath.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day guimao of the sixth month there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the first day of the sixth month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，大破赫連昌，昌奔上邽。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen he utterly defeated Helian Chang; Chang fled to Shanggui.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he shattered Helian Chang, who fled to Shanggui.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，車駕入城，虜昌群弟及其母妹妻妾宮人萬數，府庫珍寶車旗器物不可勝計。

translations.literal: On the day yisi the imperial carriage entered the city; he captured Chang's younger brothers in a body, together with their mother, sisters, wives, concubines, and palace women by the tens of thousands, while treasuries, jewels, chariots, banners, and utensils were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he entered the city and took Chang's brothers, their mother, sisters, wives, concubines, and palace women by the tens of thousands, with treasuries and spoils past numbering.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，班師。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou he led the army back.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he withdrew the army.

sentences.zh: 留常山王素、執金吾桓貸鎮統萬。

translations.literal: He left Prince of Changshan Su and Commandant of the Imperial Insignia Huan Dai to garrison and command Tongwan.
translations.idiomatic: He left Prince Su of Changshan and Commandant Huan Dai to hold Tongwan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，築壇於祚嶺，戲馬馳射，賜中者金帛繒絮各有差。

translations.literal: On the day jimao of the seventh month of autumn he built an altar on Zuo Ridge, staged horse games and mounted archery, and bestowed gold, silk, and wadding on those who hit the mark, each according to his measure.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the seventh autumn month he raised an altar on Zuo Ridge, held riding games and archery, and gave graded gifts of gold and silk to the winners.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕寇雲中，聞破赫連昌，懼而逃。

translations.literal: The Rouran raided Yunzhong; hearing that Helian Chang had been broken, they took fright and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran struck Yunzhong; learning that Chang was beaten, they fled in fear.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，車駕至自西伐，飲至策勛，告宗廟，班軍實以賜留臺百僚各有差。

translations.literal: On the day renzi of the eighth month the imperial carriage returned from the western campaign; he held the victory feast and recorded merit, reported to the ancestral temple, and distributed military booty to the hundred officials who had remained at the capital, each according to his measure.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the eighth month he returned from the western campaign, held the victory feast, reported to the temple, and divided spoils among the capital officials in graded shares.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，以氐王楊玄為假征南大將軍、都督、梁州刺史、南秦王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter he appointed the Di king Yang Xuan acting General Who Conquers the South, Area Commander, Inspector of Liang province, and King of Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh winter month he named the Di chief Yang Xuan acting General Who Conquers the South, commander, Liang inspector, and King of Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 十二月，行幸中山，守宰貪汙免者十數人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he traveled to Zhongshan; more than ten district magistrates were dismissed for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he went to Zhongshan and removed more than ten corrupt local administrators.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，車駕還宮，復所過田租之半。

translations.literal: On the day guimao the imperial carriage returned to the palace and remitted half the field tax along the route of the tour.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he returned to the capital and halved the land tax in the regions he had passed through.

sentences.zh: 神蒨元年春正月，以天下守令多非法，精選忠良悉代之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Shenqi, because prefects and magistrates throughout the realm were often lawless, he carefully selected the loyal and good and replaced them all.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Shenqi year one, finding that local administrators were often corrupt, he chose loyal men and replaced them wholesale.

sentences.zh: 辛未，京兆王黎薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Prince of Jingzhao Li died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Prince Li of Jingzhao died.

sentences.zh: 二月，改元。

translations.literal: In the second month the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 司空奚斤進軍安定。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Xi Jin advanced his army on Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Xi Jin marched on Anding.

sentences.zh: 監軍侍御史安頡出戰，禽昌。

translations.literal: Supervising Army Attendant Censor An Yi went out to battle and captured Chang alive.
translations.idiomatic: Army Supervisor An Yi took the field and seized Chang alive.

sentences.zh: 其餘眾立昌弟定為主，走還平涼。

translations.literal: The rest set up Chang's younger brother Ding as their lord and fled back to Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: The remnant made Chang's brother Ding their leader and withdrew to Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，侍中古弼送赫連昌至於京師。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi of the third month Palace Attendant Gu Bi escorted Helian Chang to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the third month Palace Attendant Gu Bi brought Helian Chang to the capital.

sentences.zh: 司空奚斤追赫連定於平涼馬髦嶺，為定所禽。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Xi Jin pursued Helian Ding to Mamiao Ridge in Pingliang and was captured by Ding.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Jin pursued Helian Ding to Mamiao Ridge in Pingliang and was taken by Ding.

sentences.zh: 將軍丘堆先在安定，聞斤敗，東走長安。

translations.literal: General Qiu Dui had earlier been at Anding; hearing that Xi Jin was defeated, he fled east to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: General Qiu Dui, who had been at Anding, heard of Xi Jin's defeat and fled east to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 帝大怒，詔頡令斬之。

translations.literal: The Emperor was greatly enraged and ordered Yi to behead Qiu Dui.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious and ordered Yi to execute Qiu Dui.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，赫連定遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Helian Ding sent envoys to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Helian Ding sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬子，西巡。

translations.literal: On the day renzi he toured the west.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he toured the west.

sentences.zh: 戊午，田於河西，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu he hunted on the west of the river and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he hunted west of the river and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 南秦王楊玄遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: King of Southern Qin Yang Xuan sent envoys to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: King Yang Xuan of Southern Qin sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 五月，乞伏熾盤死。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Qifu Chipo died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Qifu Chipo died.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，東幸廣寧，臨觀溫泉。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn he traveled east to Guangning and came to view the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month he went east to Guangning and visited the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 以太牢祭黃帝、堯、舜廟。

translations.literal: With the great offering he sacrificed at the temples of the Yellow Emperor, Yao, and Shun.
translations.idiomatic: He sacrificed with the highest victims at the temples of the Yellow Emperor, Yao, and Shun.

sentences.zh: 九月，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day yiwei of the eleventh month of winter there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the first day of the eleventh winter month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 是月，行幸河西，大校獵。

translations.literal: That month he traveled to the west of the river and held a great hunt.
translations.idiomatic: That month he toured west of the river and held a grand hunt.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen of the twelfth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the twelfth month the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 二年夏四月，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the second year, men of Song came on a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month of year two, envoys from Song arrived on a courtesy visit.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，車駕北伐。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin the imperial carriage marched north to campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the emperor marched north on campaign.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，次於沙漠，舍輜重，輕騎兼冀馬至栗水。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei of the fifth month he halted in the desert, left the baggage train, and with light cavalry and double-horsed riders together reached Chestnut Water.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the fifth month he camped in the desert, shed the train, and with light horse and double mounts reached Chestnut Water.

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕震怖，焚廬舍，絕跡西走。

translations.literal: The Rouran were shaken and terrified; they burned their dwellings and vanished without trace, fleeing west.
translations.idiomatic: The Rouran were stricken with terror; they burned their camps and fled west without a trace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，振旅凱旋於京師，告於宗廟。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter he reformed the army in triumph at the capital and reported to the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month he brought the army home in triumph at the capital and reported to the temple.

sentences.zh: 列置新人於漠南，東至濡源，西暨五原、陰山，竟三千里。

translations.literal: He arrayed the new subjects south of the desert, east to the Ruyuan, west to Wuyuan and Yinshan, three thousand li in all.
translations.idiomatic: He settled the new subjects south of the desert from the Ruyuan in the east to Wuyuan and Yinshan in the west, three thousand li across.

sentences.zh: 十一月，西巡，田於河西，至祚山而還。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he toured the west, hunted on the west of the river, and returned when he reached Mount Zuo.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he toured the west, hunted west of the river, and turned back at Mount Zuo.

sentences.zh: 五月戊午，論討敕勒功，大明賞罰。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu of the fifth month he deliberated on the merit of the campaign against the Chile and made rewards and punishments clear.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the fifth month he reviewed the Chile campaign and pronounced rewards and punishments in full.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，詔諸征鎮將軍、王公杖節邊遠者，聽開府辟召，其次增置吏員。

translations.literal: On the day jihai of the seventh month of autumn an edict allowed generals on campaign and princes and dukes bearing staffs in the far marches to open offices and recruit followers; the next rank below was to have their clerical staffs enlarged.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the seventh autumn month he allowed frontier generals and princes with command staffs to open offices and recruit aides, and ordered lesser ranks to enlarge their staffs.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔大鴻臚卿杜超假節都督冀、定、相三州諸軍事、行征南大將軍、太宰，進爵為王，鎮鄴，為諸軍節度。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi an edict made Grand Herald Du Chao acting Area Commander of the military affairs of Ji, Ding, and Xiang provinces, acting General Who Conquers the South, Grand Mentor, advanced his noble rank to prince, and stationed him at Ye to command all the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he named Grand Herald Du Chao acting commander of Ji, Ding, and Xiang, acting General Who Conquers the South, Grand Mentor, raised him to princely rank, and posted him at Ye to direct all forces.

sentences.zh: 八月，宋將到彥之自清水入河，溯流西行。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Song general Dao Yanzhi entered the river from Qingshui and rowed upstream to the west.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Song commander Dao Yanzhi entered the river at Qingshui and sailed upstream to the west.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，彥之遣將度河攻治阪，冠軍將軍安頡督諸軍擊破之。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Yanzhi sent generals across the river to attack Zhiye; Champion General An Chi supervised the armies and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Dao Yanzhi sent generals across the river against Zhiye; Champion General An Chi took command of the host and broke them.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，立密皇太后廟於鄴。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guimao, he established the temple of the Secret Empress Dowager at Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, he raised a temple to the Secret Empress Dowager at Ye.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，行幸統萬，遂征平涼。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen he traveled in state to Tongwan and then campaigned against Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he went in state to Tongwan and marched on Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 是月，馮跋死。

translations.literal: That month Feng Ba died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Feng Ba died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，冠軍將軍安頡濟河攻洛陽，丙子，拔之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day yimao, Champion General An Chi crossed the river to attack Luoyang; on the day bingzi he took it.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the tenth winter month Champion General An Chi crossed the river and struck Luoyang; on bingzi he took the city.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，安頡平武牢。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi An Chi pacified Wulao.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi An Chi pacified Wulao.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙酉，車駕至平涼。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day yiyou, the imperial carriage reached Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the eleventh month the emperor reached Pingliang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，行幸安定。

translations.literal: On the day jihai he traveled in state to Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he went in state to Anding.

sentences.zh: 庚子，帝自安西還臨平涼，遂掘塹圍守之。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi the Emperor returned from the west of Anding to Pingliang and dug trenches to besiege and hold it.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the emperor came back from west of Anding to Pingliang, dug a trench ring, and laid siege.

sentences.zh: 行幸紐城，安慰初附，赦秦、隴之人，賜復七年。

translations.literal: He traveled in state to Niucheng, comforted the newly submitted, pardoned the people of Qin and Long, and granted a seven-year tax exemption.
translations.idiomatic: He visited Niucheng, reassured the new subjects, pardoned the people of Qin and Long, and exempted them from levies for seven years.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，安頡帥諸軍攻滑臺。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou An Chi led the armies to attack Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou An Chi led the host against Huatai.

sentences.zh: 沮渠蒙遜遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: Juqu Mengxun sent envoys to present tribute at court.
translations.idiomatic: Juqu Mengxun sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，封壽光侯叔孫建為丹楊王。

translations.literal: On the day renyin he enfeoffed Marquis of Shouguang Shusun Jian as Prince of Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he made Marquis Shusun Jian of Shouguang Prince of Danyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，赫連定弟社於度洛孤面縛出降，平涼，收其珍寶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dingmao, Helian Ding's younger brother Sheyu at Luogudu bound himself and came out to surrender; Pingliang was pacified and its treasures seized.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the twelfth month Helian Ding's brother Sheyu came bound from Luogudu to surrender; Pingliang fell and its treasures were taken.

sentences.zh: 定長安、臨晉、武功守將皆奔走，關中平。

translations.literal: Ding's garrison commanders at Chang'an, Linjin, and Wugong all fled; Guanzhong was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Ding's defenders at Chang'an, Linjin, and Wugong all ran; Guanzhong was settled.

sentences.zh: 壬申，車駕還東，留巴東公延普等鎮安定。

translations.literal: On the day renshen the imperial carriage returned east, leaving Duke of Badong Yanpu and others to garrison Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the emperor turned east, leaving Duke Yanpu of Badong and others to hold Anding.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬午，車駕次木根山，大饗群臣。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, on the day renwu of the first month, the imperial carriage halted at Mount Mugen and held a great feast for the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year four, on renwu of the first month, the emperor stopped at Mount Mugen and feasted his ministers.

sentences.zh: 丙申，宋將檀道濟、王仲德從清水救滑臺。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Song generals Tan Daoji and Wang Zhongde came from Qingshui to relieve Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the Song commanders Tan Daoji and Wang Zhongde marched from Qingshui to save Huatai.

sentences.zh: 丹楊王叔孫建、汝陰公長孫道生拒之，道濟等不敢進。

translations.literal: Prince of Danyang Shusun Jian and Duke of Ruyin Changsun Daosheng barred them; Daoji and the others dared not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Shusun Jian of Danyang and Duke Changsun Daosheng of Ruyin held them off; Daoji and his fellows did not dare press forward.

sentences.zh: 是月，赫連定滅乞伏慕末。

translations.literal: That month Helian Ding destroyed Qifu Mumu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Helian Ding wiped out Qifu Mumu.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，安頡、司馬楚之平滑臺。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinyou, An Chi and Sima Chuzhi pacified Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the second month An Chi and Sima Chuzhi took Huatai.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，車駕還宮，飲至策勛，告於宗廟，賜留臺百官各有差。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou the imperial carriage returned to the palace, held the victory feast and recorded merit, reported to the ancestral temple, and bestowed rewards on the capital officials, each according to his measure.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the emperor returned to the capital, held the victory feast, reported to the temple, and gave graded gifts to the officials who had stayed behind.

sentences.zh: 戰士賜復十年。

translations.literal: Soldiers were granted a ten-year tax exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting men were exempted from levies for ten years.

sentences.zh: 定州人饑，詔開倉以振之。

translations.literal: The people of Ding province were starving; an edict ordered the granaries opened to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Ding province was starving; he ordered the storehouses opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 宋將檀道濟、王仲德東走。

translations.literal: Song generals Tan Daoji and Wang Zhongde fled east.
translations.idiomatic: The Song commanders Tan Daoji and Wang Zhongde fled east.

sentences.zh: 三月庚戌，冠軍將軍安頡獻宋俘萬餘人，甲兵三萬。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu of the third month Champion General An Chi presented more than ten thousand Song captives and thirty thousand suits of armor and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the third month Champion General An Chi presented more than ten thousand Song prisoners and thirty thousand sets of arms and armor.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，赫連定北襲沮渠蒙遜，為吐谷渾慕璝所執。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer Helian Ding raided Juqu Mengxun in the north and was seized by Murong Hui of Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth summer month Helian Ding struck north at Juqu Mengxun and was taken by Murong Hui of Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙未，蠕蠕國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day yiwei, the Rouran state sent envoys to present tribute at court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the intercalary month the Rouran sent envoys to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔散騎侍郎周紹使於宋。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Supernumerary Palace Attendant Zhou Shao to go as envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Palace Attendant Zhou Shao on embassy to Song.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，行幸河西。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiyou, he traveled in state to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the seventh autumn month he toured Hexi.

sentences.zh: 起承華宮。

translations.literal: He raised the Chenghua Palace.
translations.idiomatic: He built the Chenghua Palace.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，沮渠蒙遜遣子安周入侍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yiyou, Juqu Mengxun sent his son Anzhou to enter court service.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the eighth month Juqu Mengxun sent his son Anzhou to serve at court.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾慕璝遣使奉表，請送赫連定。

translations.literal: Murong Hui of Tuyuhun sent envoys with a memorial requesting permission to deliver Helian Ding.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Hui of Tuyuhun sent a memorial asking leave to hand over Helian Ding.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以慕璝為大將軍，封西秦王。

translations.literal: On the day jichou he appointed Murong Hui Grand General and enfeoffed him as King of Western Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he named Murong Hui Grand General and King of Western Qin.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guichou, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the ninth month the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚申，加太尉長孫嵩柱國大將軍，以左光祿大夫崔浩為司徒，征西大將軍長孫道生為司空。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen he advanced Grand Commandant Changsun Song to Pillar of State Grand General, appointed Left Honorary Grand Master Cui Hao Minister over the Masses, and Western Campaign General Changsun Daosheng Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he raised Grand Commandant Changsun Song to Pillar-of-State Grand General, named Cui Hao of the Left Honorary Grand Master rank Minister over the Masses, and Western Campaign General Changsun Daosheng Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔兼太常李順持節拜河西王沮渠蒙遜為假節、加侍中、都督涼州持節及西域羌戎諸軍事、行征西大將軍、太傅、涼州牧、涼王。

translations.literal: On the day guihai an edict ordered Acting Minister of Ceremonies Li Shun, bearing the staff of office, to invest Prince of Hexi Juqu Mengxun as acting holder of the staff, Palace Attendant, Area Commander of Liang province with staff of office and of the military affairs of the Western Regions and the Qiang and Rong of the west, Acting Western Campaign Grand General, Grand Tutor, Governor of Liang province, and Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he ordered Acting Minister of Ceremonies Li Shun, with the command staff, to invest Juqu Mengxun as Prince of Liang with acting staff, Palace Attendant, commander of Liang and western border affairs, Acting Western Campaign Grand General, Grand Tutor, and Liang governor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔曰：「范陽盧玄、博陵崔綽、趙郡李靈、河間邢穎、勃海高允、廣平遊雅、太原張偉等皆賢俊之胄，冠冕州邦，有羽儀之用。

translations.literal: On the day renshen an edict said: "Fan'yang Lu Xuan, Boling Cui Chuo, Zhao commandery Li Ling, Hejian Xing Ying, Bohai Gao Yun, Guangping You Ya, Taiyuan Zhang Wei, and others are all scions of worthy houses, the ornament of their provinces, fit to serve as ceremonial exemplars.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen an edict ran: Fan'yang Lu Xuan, Boling Cui Chuo, Zhao's Li Ling, Hejian Xing Ying, Bohai Gao Yun, Guangping You Ya, Taiyuan Zhang Wei, and the like are heirs of eminent clans, the pride of their commanderies, men fit to stand as models in court.

sentences.zh: 《易》曰：『我有好爵，吾與爾縻之。

translations.literal: The Changes says: I have fine rank; I will bind it to you.
translations.idiomatic: The Changes says: I have fine rank, and I will bind you to it.

sentences.zh: 』如玄之比，隱跡衡門，不曜名譽者，盡敕州郡以禮發遣。

translations.literal: For men like Xuan who hide their traces behind a humble gate and do not display their fame, command all provinces and commanderies to send them forth with full ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: For men like Xuan who keep to their lanes and shun renown, every province and commandery shall fetch them out with full rites.

sentences.zh: 」遂征玄等。

translations.literal: Thereupon Xuan and the others were summoned.
translations.idiomatic: Then Xuan and the rest were summoned.

sentences.zh: 州郡所遣至者數百人，皆差次敘用。

translations.literal: Those sent by the provinces and commanderies numbered several hundred; all were appointed in graded order.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred men arrived from the provinces; each was ranked and placed in office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅，詔司徒崔浩改定律令。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day wuyin, an edict ordered Minister over the Masses Cui Hao to revise the laws and ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the tenth winter month he ordered Minister over the Masses Cui Hao to revise the code.

sentences.zh: 行幸漠南。

translations.literal: He traveled in state south of the desert.
translations.idiomatic: He toured the southern desert.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，北部敕勒莫弗庫若於率其部數萬騎驅鹿獸數百萬詣行在所。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingchen, Kuruyu, tribal chief of the northern Tiele, led his tribe in tens of thousands of horsemen and drove several million head of deer and game to the imperial camp.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the eleventh month Kuruyu, chief of the northern Tiele, brought tens of thousands of horsemen of his tribe and drove millions of deer and game to the imperial camp.

sentences.zh: 帝因而大狩，以賜從者，勒石漠南，以記功德。

translations.literal: The Emperor therefore held a great hunt and bestowed game on those who followed; he carved stone south of the desert to record his merit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held a great hunt, gave the quarry to his followers, and had his deeds cut in stone on the southern desert.

sentences.zh: 宜城王奚斤坐事降爵為公。

translations.literal: Prince of Yicheng Xi Jin was demoted in rank to duke for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xi Jin of Yicheng was reduced to duke for a fault.

sentences.zh: 十二月，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，車駕至自和龍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jisi, the imperial carriage returned from Helong.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the eleventh month the emperor came back from Helong.

sentences.zh: 十二月己丑，馮弘子長樂公崇及其母弟朗、朗弟邈以遼西內屬。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jichou, Feng Hong's son Duke of Changle Chong, together with his mother's younger brother Lang, and Lang's younger brother Miao, submitted from within Liaoxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the twelfth month Feng Hong's son Duke Chong of Changle, his uncle Lang, and Lang's brother Miao came over from Liaoxi.

sentences.zh: 先是，辟召賢良而州郡多逼遣之，詔以禮申喻，任其進退。

translations.literal: Earlier, when worthy men had been summoned, the provinces and commanderies had often driven them forth by force; an edict used ceremony to explain the matter and allowed them to come or go as they wished.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, worthy men had been summoned, but provinces often drove them out by force; an edict set the rites straight and let each man choose whether to come or stay home.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月庚午，詔兼鴻臚卿李繼持節假馮崇車騎大將軍、遼西王，承制，聽置尚書已下。

translations.literal: In the spring of the second year, on the day gengwu of the second month, an edict ordered Acting Grand Herald Li Ji, bearing the staff of office, to invest Feng Chong as acting General of Chariots and Cavalry and Prince of Liaoxi, with imperial commission, and permitted him to establish offices down to the Minister Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the second month of year two he ordered Acting Grand Herald Li Ji, with the staff, to name Feng Chong acting General of Chariots and Cavalry and Prince of Liaoxi, with imperial commission and leave to staff his house down to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔兼散騎常侍宋宣使於宋。

translations.literal: On the day renwu an edict ordered Acting Palace Attendant Song Xuan to go as envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he sent Acting Palace Attendant Song Xuan on embassy to Song.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，沮渠蒙遜死，以其子牧犍為車騎將軍，改封西河王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer Juqu Mengxun died; his son Mujian was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and his title was changed to Prince of Xihe.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Juqu Mengxun died; his son Mujian was named General of Chariots and Cavalry and retitled Prince of Xihe.

sentences.zh: 六月，遣永昌王健、尚書左僕射安原督諸軍討和龍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month he sent Yongchang Wang Jian and Minister of the Left An Yuan to supervise the armies in the campaign against Helong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he sent Wang Jian of Yongchang and Left Minister An Yuan to command the attack on Helong.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔樂安王範發秦、雍兵一萬築小城於長安城內。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi an edict ordered Prince of Le'an Fan to raise ten thousand men from Qin and Yong and build a small city within the walls of Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he ordered Prince Fan of Le'an to levy ten thousand men from Qin and Yong and build an inner citadel in Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，遼西王馮崇上表求說降其父，帝不聽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn Prince of Liaoxi Feng Chong submitted a memorial asking leave to persuade his father to surrender; the Emperor did not consent.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month Prince Feng Chong of Liaoxi asked leave to talk his father into surrender; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 九月，宋人來聘，並獻馴象一。

translations.literal: In the ninth month men of Song came on a friendly mission and also presented one trained elephant.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month envoys from Song arrived on a courtesy visit and brought a tame elephant.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔兼大鴻臚卿崔賾持節拜征虜將軍楊難當為征南大將軍、儀同三司，封南秦王。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu an edict ordered Acting Grand Herald Cui Yan, bearing the staff of office, to invest Campaign General Yang Nandang as Southern Campaign Grand General, Three Precedents Peer, and King of Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he ordered Acting Grand Herald Cui Yan, with the staff, to name Campaign General Yang Nandang Southern Campaign Grand General, Three Precedents Peer, and King of Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月己巳，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on the day jisi, he proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the twelfth winter month he pardoned the empire.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸陰山北。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei he traveled in state to the north of Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he went in state to the north of Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 詔兼散騎常侍盧玄使於宋。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Acting Palace Attendant Lu Xuan to go as envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Acting Palace Attendant Lu Xuan on embassy to Song.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月乙未，車駕次於女水，大饗群臣。

translations.literal: In the spring of the third year, on the day yiwei of the first month, the imperial carriage halted at Woman River and held a great feast for the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year three, on yiwei of the first month, the emperor stopped at Woman River and feasted his ministers.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，馮弘遣使求和，帝不許。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu Feng Hong sent envoys to sue for peace; the Emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Feng Hong sent envoys to sue for peace; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，南秦王楊難當克漢中，送雍州流人七千家於長安。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen King of Southern Qin Yang Nandang took Hanzhong and sent seven thousand households of Yong province refugees to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen King Yang Nandang of Southern Qin took Hanzhong and sent seven thousand refugee households from Yong province to Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，詔以頻年屢征，有事西北，運輸之役，百姓勤勞，令郡縣括貧富以為三級，富者租賦如常，中者復二年，下窮者復三年。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day wuyin, an edict said: In recent years campaigns have been frequent and affairs in the northwest pressing; the burden of transport has worn the people. Let commanderies and districts assess wealth and poverty and divide households into three grades: the rich shall pay levies as usual, the middling shall have a two-year exemption, and the poorest shall have a three-year exemption.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the second month an edict said: Years of war in the northwest have worn the people with transport duty. Let every commandery sort households into three grades by wealth: the rich pay as before, the middling are exempt two years, the poorest three.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，行幸河西。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin he traveled in state to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he toured Hexi.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲戌，秦王赫連昌叛走。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiaxu, King Helian Chang rebelled and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the intercalary month King Helian Chang rebelled and fled.

sentences.zh: 丙子，河西候將格殺之。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi a frontier guard of Hexi intercepted and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi a Hexi frontier guard cut him down.

sentences.zh: 驗其謀反，群弟皆伏誅。

translations.literal: When his plot to rebel was verified, all his younger brothers were executed.
translations.idiomatic: His treason proved, every younger brother was put to death.

sentences.zh: 己卯，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day jimao the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 進彭城公粟爵為王。

translations.literal: Duke of Pengcheng Su was advanced in noble rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Su of Pengcheng was raised to princely rank.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳，東宮成，備置屯衛，三分西宮之一，壬午，行幸美稷，遂至隰城。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinsi, the Eastern Palace was completed and garrison guards were fully posted, one-third the scale of the Western Palace; on the day renwu he traveled in state to Meiji and then reached Xicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the seventh autumn month the Eastern Palace was finished, its guards manned to one-third the strength of the Western Palace; on renwu he went in state to Meiji and on to Xicheng.

sentences.zh: 命諸軍討山胡白龍於河西。

translations.literal: He ordered the armies to campaign against the mountain Hu leader Bai Long in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the armies to crush the mountain Hu chief Bai Long in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，克之。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi of the ninth month he took him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the ninth month they took him.

sentences.zh: 斬白龍及其將帥，屠其城。

translations.literal: Bai Long and his commanders were beheaded and his city slaughtered.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Long and his officers were beheaded and his stronghold sacked.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh winter month the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，行幸雲中。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiachen, he traveled in state to Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the twelfth month he went in state to Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 太延元年春正月乙未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the spring of the first year of Taiyan, on the first day yiwei of the first month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Taiyan year one, on yiwei, the first day of the first month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，降死罪刑已下各一等。

translations.literal: On the day renwu capital punishment and all lesser sentences were reduced by one degree.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu death sentences and all lesser penalties were commuted one degree.

sentences.zh: 癸未，出道武、明元宮人，令得嫁。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei palace women of Emperors Daowu and Mingyuan were released and permitted to marry.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei palace women from the reigns of Daowu and Mingyuan were freed to marry.

sentences.zh: 甲申，大赦改元。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen he proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the reign title.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he pardoned the empire and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，蠕蠕、焉耆、車師各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the second month the Rouran, Yanqi, and Cheshi each sent envoys to present tribute at court.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the Rouran, Yanqi, and Cheshi each sent tribute to court.

sentences.zh: 詔長安及平涼人徙在京師其孤老不能自存者，聽還鄉里。

translations.literal: An edict said: Among those relocated from Chang'an and Pingliang to the capital, any who are old, alone, and unable to support themselves may return to their native districts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allowed those moved from Chang'an and Pingliang to the capital who were old, alone, and destitute to go home.

sentences.zh: 丁未，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the emperor returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚申，進宜都公穆壽為宜都王，汝陰公長孫道生為上黨王，宜城公奚斤為恒農王，廣陵公婁伏連為廣陵王。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on the day gengshen, Duke of Yidu Mu Shou was advanced to Prince of Yidu, Duke of Ruyin Changsun Daosheng to Prince of Shangdang, Duke of Yicheng Xi Jin to Prince of Hengnong, and Duke of Guangling Lou Fulian to Prince of Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the fifth summer month Duke Mu Shou of Yidu became Prince of Yidu, Duke Changsun Daosheng of Ruyin Prince of Shangdang, Duke Xi Jin of Yicheng Prince of Hengnong, and Duke Lou Fulian of Guangling Prince of Guangling.

sentences.zh: 遣使者二十輩使西域。

translations.literal: He sent twenty envoys to the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: He sent twenty embassies to the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，行幸雲中。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu he traveled in state to Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he went in state to Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，詔曰：「去春小旱，東作不茂，憂勤克己，祈請靈佑。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiawu, an edict said: Last spring brought a slight drought and the eastern fields did not flourish. With anxious diligence I restrained myself and prayed for divine aid.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the sixth month an edict said: Last spring a light drought left the eastern fields thin. I have worn myself with care, fasting and praying for heaven's help.

sentences.zh: 豈朕精誠有感，何報應之速。

translations.literal: Could it be that my utmost sincerity moved Heaven? How swift the response!
translations.idiomatic: Has my utmost sincerity moved heaven? How swift the answer!

sentences.zh: 雲雨震灑，流澤沾渥。

translations.literal: Clouds and rain thundered down; flowing moisture soaked the land deep.
translations.idiomatic: Clouds burst and rain fell in torrents; the flood soaked the earth.

sentences.zh: 有鄙婦人持方寸玉印詣潞縣侯孫家，既而亡去，莫知所在。

translations.literal: A rustic woman bearing a jade seal a few inches square came to the house of Marquis Sun of Lu county; afterward she vanished, and none knew where she had gone.
translations.idiomatic: A country woman with a thumb-sized jade seal came to the house of Marquis Sun in Lu county, then vanished, and no one knew where she went.

sentences.zh: 印有三字，為龍鳥之形，要妙奇巧，不類人跡，文曰『旱疫平』。

translations.literal: The seal bore three characters in the form of dragon and bird, exquisite and strange beyond human craft; the inscription read: Drought and plague pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The seal bore three characters shaped as dragon and bird, wrought with uncanny finesse no human hand could match; the text read, Drought and plague pacified.

sentences.zh: 推尋其理，蓋神靈之報應也。

translations.literal: When the meaning was pursued, it was surely a response of the numinous spirits.
translations.idiomatic: Pondering its meaning, it must be the spirits' answer.

sentences.zh: 比者以來，禎瑞仍臻，甘露流液，降於殿內；

translations.literal: In recent times auspicious omens have come in succession: sweet dew flowed and descended within the halls;
translations.idiomatic: Of late good omens have crowded in: sweet dew ran down within the palace halls;

sentences.zh: 嘉瓜合蒂，生於中山；

translations.literal: fine melons grew with joined stems in Zhongshan;
translations.idiomatic: fine melons with joined stems grew in Zhongshan;

sentences.zh: 野木連理，殖於魏郡；

translations.literal: wild trees joined in shared trunks in Wei commandery;
translations.idiomatic: wild trees grew with fused trunks in Wei commandery;

sentences.zh: 在先後載誕之鄉，白燕集於盛樂舊都，玄鳥隨之，蓋有千數；

translations.literal: in the homeland where the former empresses were born, white swallows gathered at the old capital of Shengle and dark swallows followed, numbering perhaps a thousand;
translations.idiomatic: in the birthplace of the late empresses, white swallows gathered at the old capital of Shengle and dark swallows followed by the thousand;

sentences.zh: 嘉禾頻歲合秀於恒農；

translations.literal: fine grain year after year bore joined ears in Hengnong;
translations.idiomatic: year after year fine grain bore double ears in Hengnong;

sentences.zh: 白兔並見於勃海，白雉三隻又集於平陽太祖之廟。

translations.literal: White hares appeared together in Bohai, and three white pheasants gathered again at the temple of Grand Ancestor Taizu in Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: White hares were seen together in Bohai, and three white pheasants again gathered at the temple of Grand Ancestor Taizu in Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 天降嘉貺，將何德以酬之？

translations.literal: Heaven has sent such gracious gifts—by what virtue shall we repay them?
translations.idiomatic: Heaven has sent such gracious gifts—by what virtue shall we repay them?

sentences.zh: 其令天下大酺五日，禮報百神，守宰祭界內名山大川，上答天意。」

translations.literal: Let the realm hold a grand feast for five days, perform rites to repay the hundred spirits, and let prefects and magistrates sacrifice to the famous mountains and great rivers within their borders, thereby answering Heaven's intent."
translations.idiomatic: Let the realm hold a grand feast for five days, perform rites to repay the hundred spirits, and let prefects and magistrates sacrifice to the famous mountains and great rivers within their borders, thereby answering Heaven's intent."

sentences.zh: 丙午，高麗、鄯善國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Goguryeo and the kingdom of Shanshan both sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Goguryeo and Shanshan both sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，田於棝陽。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he hunted at Yuyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month he hunted at Yuyang.

sentences.zh: 己卯，樂平王丕等五將東伐，至和龍，徙男女六千口而還。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Prince of Leping Wang Pi and five other generals campaigned eastward; reaching Helong, they moved sixty thousand men and women back and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Prince of Leping Wang Pi and five other generals marched east; reaching Helong, they moved sixty thousand men and women back and returned.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，行幸河西。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the eighth month he traveled in state to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the eighth month he traveled in state to Hexi.

sentences.zh: 粟特國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: The kingdom of Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Sogdiana sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，尚書左僕射安原謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guimao, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing An Yuan plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the tenth winter month Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing An Yuan plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，行幸定州，次於新城宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen he traveled in state to Dingzhou and halted at Xincheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he traveled in state to Dingzhou and halted at Xincheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，校獵於廣川。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jisi, he conducted a battue hunt at Guangchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the eleventh month he conducted a battue hunt at Guangchuan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，行幸鄴，祀密太后廟。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi he traveled in state to Ye and sacrificed at the temple of the Secret Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he traveled in state to Ye and sacrificed at the temple of the Secret Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 諸所過親問高年，褒禮賢俊。

translations.literal: Wherever he passed he personally inquired after the aged and honored and rewarded the worthy and eminent.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he passed he personally inquired after the aged and honored and rewarded the worthy and eminent.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，遣使者以太牢祀北嶽。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day guimao, he dispatched envoys to sacrifice to the Northern Peak with the great offering.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guimao, he dispatched envoys to sacrifice to the Northern Peak with the great offering.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲寅，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on the day jiayin, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year, on jiayin in the first month, the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，馮弘遣使朝貢，求送侍子，帝不許。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi Feng Hong sent envoys with tribute, requesting to send a hostage son; the Emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Feng Hong sent envoys with tribute, requesting to send a hostage son; the emperor did not permit it.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣使者十餘輩詣高麗、東夷諸國，詔喻之。

translations.literal: On the day renchen he dispatched more than ten envoys to Goguryeo and the eastern Yi states to proclaim and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he dispatched more than ten envoys to Goguryeo and the eastern Yi states to proclaim and instruct them.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣平東將軍娥清、安西將軍古弼討馮弘。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei he dispatched Pacifier of the East General E Qing and Pacifier of the West General Gu Bi to attack Feng Hong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he dispatched Pacifier of the East General E Qing and Pacifier of the West General Gu Bi to attack Feng Hong.

sentences.zh: 弘求救於高麗，高麗遣其大將葛蔓盧迎之。

translations.literal: Hong sought rescue from Goguryeo; Goguryeo sent its great general Ge Manlu to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: Hong sought rescue from Goguryeo; Goguryeo sent its great general Ge Manlu to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 帝校獵於河西，詔廣平公張黎發定州七郡一萬二千人通莎泉道。

translations.literal: The Emperor conducted a battue hunt in Hexi and ordered Duke of Guangping Zhang Li to mobilize twelve thousand men from seven commanderies of Dingzhou to open the Shachuan road.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor conducted a battue hunt in Hexi and ordered Duke of Guangping Zhang Li to mobilize twelve thousand men from seven commanderies of Dingzhou to open the Shachuan road.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，高車國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen the Gaoche state sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Gaoche state sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，樂平王丕等至，略陽公難當奉詔攝上邽守。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu in the ninth month Prince of Leping Wang Pi and others arrived; Duke of Lueyang Nan Dang received the edict to act as provisional governor of Shanggui.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the ninth month Prince of Leping Wang Pi and others arrived; Duke of Lueyang Nan Dang received the edict to act as provisional governor of Shanggui.

sentences.zh: 高麗不送馮弘，帝將伐之，納樂平王丕計而止。

translations.literal: Goguryeo did not hand over Feng Hong; the Emperor was about to attack them but accepted Prince of Leping Wang Pi's plan and desisted.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo did not hand over Feng Hong; the emperor was about to attack them but accepted Prince of Leping Wang Pi's plan and desisted.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己酉，幸棝陽。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day jiyou, he visited Yuyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the eleventh winter month he visited Yuyang.

sentences.zh: 驅野馬於雲中，置野馬苑。

translations.literal: He drove wild horses in Yunzhong and established the Wild Horse Park.
translations.idiomatic: He drove wild horses in Yunzhong and established the Wild Horse Park.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬子，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day renzi, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on renzi, the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，改封潁川王提為武昌王。

translations.literal: On the day yichou he changed the enfeoffment of Prince of Yingchuan Ti to Prince of Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he changed the enfeoffment of Prince of Yingchuan Ti to Prince of Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 河西王沮渠牧犍遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: King of Hexi Juqu Mujian sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: King of Hexi Juqu Mujian sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐谷渾慕璝死。

translations.literal: That year Murong Hui of Tuyuhun died.
translations.idiomatic: That year Murong Hui of Tuyuhun died.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月庚寅，行幸定州。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the day gengyin, he traveled in state to Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifth year, on gengyin in the first month, he traveled in state to Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月辛未，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day xinwei, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinwei, the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以故南秦王世子楊保宗為征南大將軍、秦州牧、武都王，鎮上邽。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin he appointed the former heir of the Southern Qin king Yang Baozong as Grand General Who Conquers the South, Governor of Qinzhou, King of Wudu, and stationed him at Shanggui.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he appointed the former heir of the Southern Qin king Yang Baozong as Grand General Who Conquers the South, Governor of Qinzhou, King of Wudu, and stationed him at Shanggui.

sentences.zh: 夏五月癸未，遮逸國獻汗血馬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on the day guiwei, the kingdom of Zheyi presented sweat-blood horses.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the fifth summer month the kingdom of Zheyi presented sweat-blood horses.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，車駕西討沮渠牧犍。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen in the sixth month the imperial carriage campaigned west against Juqu Mujian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the sixth month the emperor campaigned west against Juqu Mujian.

sentences.zh: 侍中、宜都王穆壽輔皇太子決留臺事，大將軍長樂王嵇敬、輔國大將軍建寧王崇二萬人屯漠南，以備蠕蠕。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Prince of Yidu Mu Shou assisted the crown prince in deciding matters left at the capital; Grand General Prince of Changle Ji Jing and Assistant General Who Supports the State Prince of Jianning Chong, twenty thousand men, encamped south of the desert to guard against the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Prince of Yidu Mu Shou assisted the crown prince in deciding matters left at the capital; Grand General Prince of Changle Ji Jing and Assistant General Who Supports the State Prince of Jianning Chong, twenty thousand men, encamped south of the desert to guard against the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，車駕至上都屬國城，大饗群臣，講武馬射。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jisi, the imperial carriage reached Shangdu Shuguocheng, held a great feast for the ministers, and lectured on martial arts with mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the seventh autumn month the emperor reached Shangdu Shuguocheng, held a great feast for the ministers, and lectured on martial arts with mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 壬午，留輜重，分部諸軍。

translations.literal: On the day renwu he left the baggage train and divided the armies.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he left the baggage train and divided the armies.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，車駕至姑臧，牧犍兄子祖逾城來降。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the eighth month the imperial carriage reached Guzang; Mujian's nephew Zu Yue came over the walls to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the eighth month the emperor reached Guzang; Mujian's nephew Zu Yue came over the walls to surrender.

sentences.zh: 乃分軍圍之。

translations.literal: Thereupon he divided the army to besiege the city.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he divided the army to besiege the city.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，牧犍與左右文武五千人面縛軍門，帝解其縛，待以籓臣之禮。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the ninth month Mujian, with five thousand civil and military followers left and right, came bound at the army gate; the Emperor released their bonds and treated them with the rites due a feudatory minister.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the ninth month Mujian, with five thousand civil and military followers left and right, came bound at the army gate; the emperor released their bonds and treated them with the rites due a feudatory minister.

sentences.zh: 收其城內戶口二十餘萬，倉庫珍寶不可稱計。

translations.literal: He took more than two hundred thousand households within the city and storehouses of treasures beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: He took more than two hundred thousand households within the city and storehouses of treasures beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 進張掖公禿發保周爵為王，與龍驤將軍穆羆、安遠將軍源賀分略諸郡。

translations.literal: He advanced Duke of Zhangye Tufa Baozhou to king and, with General of the Flying Dragon Mu Pi and General Who Pacifies the Distance Yuan He, divided forces to reduce the various commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced Duke of Zhangye Tufa Baozhou to king and, with General of the Flying Dragon Mu Pi and General Who Pacifies the Distance Yuan He, divided forces to reduce the various commanderies.

sentences.zh: 牧犍弟張掖太守宜得西奔酒泉太守無諱，後奔晉昌；

translations.literal: Mujian's younger brother, Governor of Zhangye Yide, fled west to Governor of Jiuquan Wu Hui and later fled to Jinchang;
translations.idiomatic: Mujian's younger brother, Governor of Zhangye Yide, fled west to Governor of Jiuquan Wu Hui and later fled to Jinchang;

sentences.zh: 樂都太守安周南奔吐谷渾。

translations.literal: Governor of Ledu An Zhou fled south to Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Ledu An Zhou fled south to Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 戊子，蠕蠕犯塞，遂至七介山，京都大駭。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi the Rouran raided the frontier and reached Qijie Mountain; the capital was greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the Rouran raided the frontier and reached Qijie Mountain; the capital was greatly alarmed.

sentences.zh: 皇太子命上黨王長孫道生等拒之。

translations.literal: The crown prince ordered Prince of Shangdang Changsun Daosheng and others to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince ordered Prince of Shangdang Changsun Daosheng and others to resist them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day xinyou, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the tenth winter month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 徙涼州人三萬餘家於京師。

translations.literal: He moved more than thirty thousand families of Liangzhou people to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He moved more than thirty thousand families of Liangzhou people to the capital.

sentences.zh: 留樂平王丕、征西將軍賀多羅鎮涼州。

translations.literal: He left Prince of Leping Wang Pi and General Who Conquers the West He Duoluo to guard Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He left Prince of Leping Wang Pi and General Who Conquers the West He Duoluo to guard Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，遣張掖王禿發保周喻諸部鮮卑，保周因率諸部叛於張掖。

translations.literal: On the day guihai he dispatched King of Zhangye Tufa Baozhou to instruct the various Xianbei tribes; Baozhou thereupon led the tribes in rebellion at Zhangye.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he dispatched King of Zhangye Tufa Baozhou to instruct the various Xianbei tribes; Baozhou thereupon led the tribes in rebellion at Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，宋人來聘，並獻馴象一。

translations.literal: On the day yisi envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy and also presented one trained elephant.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy and also presented one trained elephant.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，車駕至自西伐，飲至策勛，告於宗廟。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the twelfth month the imperial carriage returned from the western campaign, held a drinking ceremony to distribute rewards, and reported to the ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the twelfth month the emperor returned from the western campaign, held a drinking ceremony to distribute rewards, and reported to the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 楊難當寇上邽，鎮將元勿頭討走之。

translations.literal: Yang Nan Dang raided Shanggui; the garrison commander Yuan Wutou attacked and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Nan Dang raided Shanggui; the garrison commander Yuan Wutou attacked and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 是歲，鄯善、龜茲、疏勒、焉耆、高麗、粟特、渴盤陀、破洛那、悉居半等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Shanshan, Kucha, Kashgar, Karashahr, Goguryeo, Sogdiana, Khotan, Bactria, Sarmatia, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Shanshan, Kucha, Kashgar, Karashahr, Goguryeo, Sogdiana, Khotan, Bactria, Sarmatia, and other states all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月，酒泉陷。

translations.literal: In the third month Jiuquan fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Jiuquan fell.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month of summer, the day wuwu, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, the first day of the fourth summer month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，沮渠無諱寇張掖。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen Juqu Wu Hui raided Zhangye.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Juqu Wu Hui raided Zhangye.

sentences.zh: 禿發保周屯刪丹。

translations.literal: Tufa Baozhou encamped at Shandan.
translations.idiomatic: Tufa Baozhou encamped at Shandan.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，皇孫浚生，大赦改元。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou in the sixth month the imperial grandson Jun was born; a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the sixth month the imperial grandson Jun was born; a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn he traveled in state to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month he traveled in state to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 己丑，永昌王健大破禿發保周，走之。

translations.literal: On the day jichou Prince of Yongchang Jian greatly defeated Tufa Baozhou and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Prince of Yongchang Jian greatly defeated Tufa Baozhou and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 丙申，保太后竇氏崩於行宮。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen Empress Dowager Bao Lady Dou died at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Empress Dowager Bao Lady Dou died at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，保周自殺，傳首京師。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Baozhou killed himself; his head was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Baozhou killed himself; his head was sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，沮渠無諱降。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Juqu Wu Hui surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Juqu Wu Hui surrendered.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the ninth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the ninth month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是歲，州鎮十五饑，詔開倉振恤之。

translations.literal: That year fifteen provinces and garrisons suffered famine; an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year fifteen provinces and garrisons suffered famine; an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 以河南主曜子羯兒為河間王，後改封略陽王。

translations.literal: The son of Princess Henan Yao, Jie'er, was made Prince of Hejian and later changed to Prince of Lueyang.
translations.idiomatic: The son of Princess Henan Yao, Jie'er, was made Prince of Hejian and later changed to Prince of Lueyang.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙子，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi in the twelfth month envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the twelfth month envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月庚午，行幸中山。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on the day gengwu, he traveled in state to Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourth year, on gengwu in the first month, he traveled in state to Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，次於恒山之陽，詔有司刊石勒銘。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi in the second month he halted south of Mount Heng and ordered the officials to carve stone and inscribe an inscription.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the second month he halted south of Mount Heng and ordered the officials to carve stone and inscribe an inscription.

sentences.zh: 是月，克仇池。

translations.literal: That month Chouchi was taken.
translations.idiomatic: That month Chouchi was taken.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the third month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the third month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，武都王楊保宗謀反，諸將禽送京師。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer King of Wudu Yang Baozong plotted rebellion; the generals captured him and sent him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month King of Wudu Yang Baozong plotted rebellion; the generals captured him and sent him to the capital.

sentences.zh: 氐、羌復推保宗弟文德為主，圍仇池。

translations.literal: The Di and Qiang again set up his younger brother Wendé as leader and besieged Chouchi.
translations.idiomatic: The Di and Qiang again set up his younger brother Wendé as leader and besieged Chouchi.

sentences.zh: 六月庚寅，詔復人貲賦三年，其田租歲輸如常，牧守不得妄有征發。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the sixth month an edict remitted the poll tax for three years; the field tax was to be delivered yearly as usual, and prefects and magistrates were not to levy requisitions at will.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the sixth month an edict remitted the poll tax for three years; the field tax was to be delivered yearly as usual, and prefects and magistrates were not to levy requisitions at will.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，大閱於西郊。

translations.literal: On the day guisi a great review was held at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi a great review was held at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 九月辛丑，行幸漠南。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the ninth month he traveled in state to the desert south.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the ninth month he traveled in state to the desert south.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，舍輜重，以輕騎襲蠕蠕，分軍為四道。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen he left the baggage train and with light cavalry raided the Rouran, dividing the army into four columns.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he left the baggage train and with light cavalry raided the Rouran, dividing the army into four columns.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲子，車駕還至朔方。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day jiazi, the imperial carriage returned to Shuofang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eleventh winter month the emperor returned to Shuofang.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「夫陰陽有往復，四時有代謝，授子任賢，蓋古今不易之令典也。
