translations.literal: An edict said: "Yin and yang have their return and recurrence, the four seasons have their succession and replacement; entrusting sons and employing the worthy are ordinances unchanging through antiquity and the present.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "Yin and yang have their return and recurrence, the four seasons have their succession and replacement; entrusting sons and employing the worthy are ordinances unchanging through antiquity and the present.

sentences.zh: 其令皇太子副理萬機，總統百揆。

translations.literal: Let the crown prince assist in governing the myriad affairs and preside over the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: Let the crown prince assist in governing the myriad affairs and preside over the hundred offices.

sentences.zh: 諸功臣勤勞日久，皆當以爵歸第，隨時朝請，饗宴朕前，論道陳謨而己，不宜復煩以劇職。

translations.literal: The various meritorious ministers who have labored long should all return their ranks to their estates, attending court at the proper seasons, feasting before Us and discussing the Way and presenting counsel—that is all; they should not again be burdened with arduous offices.
translations.idiomatic: The various meritorious ministers who have labored long should all return their ranks to their estates, attending court at the proper seasons, feasting before Us and discussing the Way and presenting counsel—that is all; they should not again be burdened with arduous offices.

sentences.zh: 更舉賢俊，以備百官，明為科制，以稱朕心。

translations.literal: Select worthy and eminent men anew to fill the hundred offices, clarify the statutes and systems, thereby matching Our intent.
translations.idiomatic: Select worthy and eminent men anew to fill the hundred offices, clarify the statutes and systems, thereby matching Our intent.

sentences.zh: 」十二月辛卯，車駕至自北伐。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth month, on the day xinmao, the imperial carriage returned from the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twelfth month, on xinmao, the emperor returned from the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月壬寅，皇太子始總百揆。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the day renyin, the crown prince began to preside over the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fifth year, on renyin in the first month, the crown prince began to preside over the hundred offices.

sentences.zh: 侍中中書監宜都王穆壽、司徒東都公崔浩、侍中廣平公張黎、侍中建興公古弼輔太子以決庶政。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant and Director of the Palace Secretariat Prince of Yidu Mu Shou, Minister of Education Duke of the Eastern Capital Cui Hao, Palace Attendant Duke of Guangping Zhang Li, and Palace Attendant Duke of Jianxing Gu Bi assisted the crown prince in deciding ordinary government.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant and Director of the Palace Secretariat Prince of Yidu Mu Shou, Minister of Education Duke of the Eastern Capital Cui Hao, Palace Attendant Duke of Guangping Zhang Li, and Palace Attendant Duke of Jianxing Gu Bi assisted the crown prince in deciding ordinary government.

sentences.zh: 諸上書者皆稱臣，上疏儀與表同。

translations.literal: All who submitted memorials above addressed themselves as subjects; the protocol for memorials was the same as for tables.
translations.idiomatic: All who submitted memorials above addressed themselves as subjects; the protocol for memorials was the same as for tables.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔自王公已下至於庶人，私養沙門、巫及金銀工巧之人在其家者，皆遣詣官曹，限今年二月十五日。

translations.literal: On the day wushen an edict ordered that from kings and dukes down to commoners, whoever privately kept Buddhist monks, shamans, or workers in gold, silver, and craft within the household must send them to the official bureaus, with a deadline of the fifteenth day of the second month this year.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict ordered that from kings and dukes down to commoners, whoever privately kept Buddhist monks, shamans, or workers in gold, silver, and craft within the household must send them to the official bureaus, with a deadline of the fifteenth day of the second month this year.

sentences.zh: 過期不出，巫、沙門身死，主人門誅。

translations.literal: Those who did not come forth after the deadline: shamans and monks were put to death, and their masters' households were punished to the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Those who did not come forth after the deadline: shamans and monks were put to death, and their masters' households were punished to the gate.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔自三公已下至於卿士，其子息皆詣太學，其百工伎巧騶卒子息當習其父兄所業，不聽私立學校，違者師身死，主人門誅。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu an edict ordered that from the Three Excellencies down to ministers and grandees, their sons must all go to the Imperial Academy; the sons of the hundred crafts, artisans, grooms, and runners were to study their fathers' and elder brothers' trades and were not permitted to establish private schools—violators: the teacher was put to death and the master's household punished to the gate.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu an edict ordered that from the Three Excellencies down to ministers and grandees, their sons must all go to the Imperial Academy; the sons of the hundred crafts, artisans, grooms, and runners were to study their fathers' and elder brothers' trades and were not permitted to establish private schools—violators: the teacher was put to death and the master's household punished to the gate.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，中山王辰等八人以北伐後期，斬於都南。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the second month Prince of Zhongshan Chen and eight others were beheaded south of the capital for being late after the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the second month Prince of Zhongshan Chen and eight others were beheaded south of the capital for being late after the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，樂平王丕薨。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou Prince of Leping Wang Pi died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Prince of Leping Wang Pi died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，行幸廬。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen he traveled in state to Lu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he traveled in state to Lu.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，大會於那南。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen in the third month a great assembly was held south of Na.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the third month a great assembly was held south of Na.

sentences.zh: 遣使者四輩使西域。

translations.literal: He dispatched four envoys to the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched four envoys to the Western Regions.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，太宰、陽平王杜超為帳下所殺。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the fourth month of summer the Grand Preceptor, Prince of Yangping Du Chao, was killed by men of his tent guard.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the fourth summer month the Grand Preceptor, Prince of Yangping Du Chao, was killed by men of his tent guard.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉，行幸陰山北。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the fifth month he traveled in state north of Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the fifth month he traveled in state north of Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 六月，西平王吐谷渾慕利延殺其兄子緯代，立緯弟，叱力延等來奔，乞師。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Prince of Xiping Tuyuhun Murong Liyan killed his elder brother's son Weidai and installed Weidai's younger brother; Chiliyan and others came fleeing to submit and begged for troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Prince of Xiping Tuyuhun Murong Liyan killed his elder brother's son Weidai and installed Weidai's younger brother; Chiliyan and others came fleeing to submit and begged for troops.

sentences.zh: 以叱力延為歸義王。

translations.literal: Chiliyan was made King Who Returns to Righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Chiliyan was made King Who Returns to Righteousness.

sentences.zh: 秋八月乙丑，田於河西。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the day yichou, he hunted in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the eighth autumn month he hunted in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔員外散騎常侍高濟使於宋。

translations.literal: On the day renwu he ordered Supernumerary Palace Attendant Gao Ji as envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he ordered Supernumerary Palace Attendant Gao Ji as envoy to Song.

sentences.zh: 九月，帝自河西至於馬邑，觀於崞川。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Emperor came from Hexi to Mayi and reviewed troops at Chuochuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor came from Hexi to Mayi and reviewed troops at Chuochuan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day jihai the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丁未，行幸漠南。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei he traveled in state to the desert south.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he traveled in state to the desert south.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸未，晉王伏羅大破慕利延。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guiwei, Prince of Jin Fu Luo greatly defeated Murong Liyan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the tenth winter month Prince of Jin Fu Luo greatly defeated Murong Liyan.

sentences.zh: 慕利延走奔白蘭，其部一萬三千內附。

translations.literal: Murong Liyan fled to Bailan; thirteen thousand of his tribes submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Liyan fled to Bailan; thirteen thousand of his tribes submitted.

sentences.zh: 十一月，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙戌，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the twelfth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the twelfth month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛亥，行幸定州，引見長老，存問之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on the day xinhai, he traveled in state to Dingzhou, summoned the elders, and inquired after them.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the sixth year, on xinhai in the first month, he traveled in state to Dingzhou, summoned the elders, and inquired after them.

sentences.zh: 詔兼員外散騎常侍宋愔使於宋。

translations.literal: He ordered Concurrent Supernumerary Palace Attendant Song Yin as envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Concurrent Supernumerary Palace Attendant Song Yin as envoy to Song.

sentences.zh: 二月，遂西幸上黨，觀連理樹於玄氏。

translations.literal: In the second month he then traveled west to Shangdang and viewed the intertwined trees at Xuanshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he then traveled west to Shangdang and viewed the intertwined trees at Xuanshi.

sentences.zh: 至吐京，討徙叛胡，出配郡縣。

translations.literal: Reaching Tujing, he attacked the relocated rebel Hu and sent them out to be assigned to commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Tujing, he attacked the relocated rebel Hu and sent them out to be assigned to commanderies and counties.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the third month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the third month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 詔諸有疑獄皆付中書，以經義量決。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that all doubtful criminal cases be handed to the Palace Secretariat to be decided by weighing canonical principles.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that all doubtful criminal cases be handed to the Palace Secretariat to be decided by weighing canonical principles.

sentences.zh: 夏六月戊子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, on the first day wuzi, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the first day of the sixth summer month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，北巡。

translations.literal: On the day renchen he toured the north.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen he toured the north.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬辰，散騎常侍成周公萬度歸以輕騎至鄯善，執其王真達，與詣京師。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the eighth month of autumn Supernumerary Palace Attendant Duke of Chengwu Wan Dugui with light cavalry reached Shanshan, seized its king Zhenda, and brought him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the eighth autumn month Supernumerary Palace Attendant Duke of Chengwu Wan Dugui with light cavalry reached Shanshan, seized its king Zhenda, and brought him to the capital.

sentences.zh: 帝大悅，厚待之。

translations.literal: The Emperor was greatly pleased and treated him generously.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased and treated him generously.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸陰山北，次於廣德宮。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage visited north of Yinshan and halted at Guangde Palace.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor visited north of Yinshan and halted at Guangde Palace.

sentences.zh: 詔發天下兵，三取一，各當戒嚴，以須後命。

translations.literal: An edict mobilized troops throughout the realm, one man in three, each to stand in readiness awaiting further orders.
translations.idiomatic: An edict mobilized troops throughout the realm, one man in three, each to stand in readiness awaiting further orders.

sentences.zh: 徙諸種雜人五千餘家於北邊。

translations.literal: More than five thousand families of various mixed peoples were moved to the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: More than five thousand families of various mixed peoples were moved to the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 令人北徙畜牧至廣漠，以餌蠕蠕。

translations.literal: People were ordered north to pasture livestock as far as the broad desert to bait the Rouran.
translations.idiomatic: People were ordered north to pasture livestock as far as the broad desert to bait the Rouran.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月戊辰，車駕次東雍，禽薛永宗，斬之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on the day wuchen the imperial carriage halted at Dongyong, captured Xue Yongzong, and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the seventh year, on wuchen in the first month, the emperor halted at Dongyong, captured Xue Yongzong, and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 其男女無少長皆赴水死。

translations.literal: His men and women, none young or old, all threw themselves into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: His men and women, none young or old, all threw themselves into the water and died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，南幸汾陰。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei he traveled south to Fenyin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he traveled south to Fenyin.

sentences.zh: 蓋吳退走北地。

translations.literal: Gai Wu retreated and fled to Beidi.
translations.idiomatic: Gai Wu retreated and fled to Beidi.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，幸長安，存問父老。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the second month he visited Chang'an and inquired after the elders.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the second month he visited Chang'an and inquired after the elders.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，幸昆明池，遂田於岐山之陽。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai he visited Kunming Pool and then hunted south of Mount Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he visited Kunming Pool and then hunted south of Mount Qi.

sentences.zh: 所過誅與蓋吳通謀反害守將者。

translations.literal: Wherever he passed he executed those who had conspired with Gai Wu in rebellion and harmed the garrison commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he passed he executed those who had conspired with Gai Wu in rebellion and harmed the garrison commanders.

sentences.zh: 三月，詔諸州坑沙門，毀諸佛像，徙長安城內工巧二千家於京師。

translations.literal: In the third month an edict ordered the various provinces to bury Buddhist monks alive and destroy Buddhist images; two thousand families of artisans in Chang'an city were moved to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month an edict ordered the various provinces to bury Buddhist monks alive and destroy Buddhist images; two thousand families of artisans in Chang'an city were moved to the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，車駕至自長安。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen in the fourth month of summer the imperial carriage returned from Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the fourth summer month the emperor returned from Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 戊子，毀鄴城五層佛圖，於泥像中得玉璽二，其文皆曰：「受命於天，既壽永昌」。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi he destroyed the five-story Buddhist pagoda at Ye city; within the clay images two jade seals were found, both inscribed: "Having received the mandate from Heaven, long life and eternal prosperity."
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he destroyed the five-story Buddhist pagoda at Ye city; within the clay images two jade seals were found, both inscribed: "Having received the mandate from Heaven, long life and eternal prosperity."

sentences.zh: 其一刻其旁曰「魏所受漢傳國璽」。

translations.literal: On one was carved at the side: "The seal of Han transmitted to Wei."
translations.idiomatic: On one was carved at the side: "The seal of Han transmitted to Wei."

sentences.zh: 五月，蓋吳復聚杏城，自號秦地王。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Gai Wu again gathered at Xingcheng and styled himself King of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Gai Wu again gathered at Xingcheng and styled himself King of Qin.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，發司、幽、定、冀四州十萬人築畿上塞圍，起上谷，西至於河，廣袤皆千里。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu he mobilized one hundred thousand men from the four provinces of Si, You, Ding, and Ji to build the encircling barrier on the capital frontier, from Shanggu west to the Yellow River, a thousand li in breadth and length.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he mobilized one hundred thousand men from the four provinces of Si, You, Ding, and Ji to build the encircling barrier on the capital frontier, from Shanggu west to the Yellow River, a thousand li in breadth and length.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day guiwei in the sixth month there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the first day of the sixth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，蓋吳為其下人所殺，傳首京師。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn Gai Wu was killed by his own followers; his head was sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month Gai Wu was killed by his own followers; his head was sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 復略陽公羯兒王爵。

translations.literal: Duke of Lueyang Jie'er's royal rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Lueyang Jie'er's royal rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the ninth year, first month, envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，行幸定州。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the second month he traveled in state to Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the second month he traveled in state to Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 山東人饑，詔開倉振之。

translations.literal: The people east of the mountains suffered famine; an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: The people east of the mountains suffered famine; an edict ordered the granaries opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 罷塞圍作。

translations.literal: Work on the frontier encircling barrier was halted.
translations.idiomatic: Work on the frontier encircling barrier was halted.

sentences.zh: 遂西幸上黨。

translations.literal: He then traveled west to Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: He then traveled west to Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 詔於壺關東北大王山累石為三封，又斬其鳳凰山南足以斷之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered piling stones into three mounds east of Huguan on Great King Mountain, and also cutting away the southern foot of Phoenix Mountain to sever it.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered piling stones into three mounds east of Huguan on Great King Mountain, and also cutting away the southern foot of Phoenix Mountain to sever it.

sentences.zh: 三月，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: In the third month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲戌，以交趾公韓拔為假征西將軍、領護西戎校尉、鄯善王，鎮鄯善，賦役其人，比之郡縣。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the fifth month of summer Duke of Jiaozhi Han Ba was made Acting General Who Conquers the West, Concurrent Protector of the Western Rong, King of Shanshan, stationed at Shanshan, and levied corvée on the people there as in commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the fifth summer month Duke of Jiaozhi Han Ba was made Acting General Who Conquers the West, Concurrent Protector of the Western Rong, King of Shanshan, stationed at Shanshan, and levied corvée on the people there as in commanderies and counties.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，行幸廣德宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the sixth month he traveled in state to Guangde Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the sixth month he traveled in state to Guangde Palace.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，悅般國遣使求與王師俱討蠕蠕。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao the kingdom of Yueban sent envoys requesting to campaign against the Rouran together with the royal army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the kingdom of Yueban sent envoys requesting to campaign against the Rouran together with the royal army.

sentences.zh: 帝許之。

translations.literal: The Emperor permitted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor permitted it.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，詔中外諸軍戒嚴。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn an edict ordered all armies within and without to stand in readiness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month an edict ordered all armies within and without to stand in readiness.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，練兵於西郊。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou in the ninth month he drilled troops at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the ninth month he drilled troops at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，幸陰山。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu he visited Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he visited Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 是月，成周公萬度歸千里驛上：大破焉耆國，其王鳩屍卑那奔龜茲。

translations.literal: That month Duke of Chengwu Wan Dugui reported by relay post from a thousand li: he had greatly defeated the kingdom of Karashahr; its king Jumoshibina fled to Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: That month Duke of Chengwu Wan Dugui reported by relay post from a thousand li: he had greatly defeated the kingdom of Karashahr; its king Jumoshibina fled to Kucha.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑，恒農王奚斤薨。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day xinchou, Prince of Hengnong Xi Jin died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the tenth winter month Prince of Hengnong Xi Jin died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以婚姻奢靡，喪葬過度，詔有司更為科限。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, because marriage was extravagant and funerals excessive, an edict ordered the officials to revise the statutes and limits.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, because marriage was extravagant and funerals excessive, an edict ordered the officials to revise the statutes and limits.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day guihai a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，詔成周公萬度歸自焉耆西討龜茲。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month an edict ordered Duke of Chengwu Wan Dugui to campaign west from Karashahr against Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month an edict ordered Duke of Chengwu Wan Dugui to campaign west from Karashahr against Kucha.

sentences.zh: 皇太子朝於行宮。

translations.literal: The crown prince attended court at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince attended court at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 遂從北討。

translations.literal: He then followed the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 至受降城，不見蠕蠕，因積糧城內，留守而還。

translations.literal: Reaching Shouxiang City, they did not encounter the Rouran; they therefore stored grain within the city, garrisoned it, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Shouxiang City, they did not encounter the Rouran; they therefore stored grain within the city, garrisoned it, and returned.

sentences.zh: 北平王長孫敦坐事降爵為公。

translations.literal: Prince of Beiping Changsun Dun was demoted to duke for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Beiping Changsun Dun was demoted to duke for an offense.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月戊辰朔，帝在漠南，大饗百寮。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, spring, first month, on the first day wuchen the Emperor was in the desert south and held a great feast for the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the tenth year, on wuchen, the first day of the first month, the emperor was in the desert south and held a great feast for the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，蠕蠕吐賀真懼，遠遁。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu Tuhuzhen of the Rouran was afraid and fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Tuhuzhen of the Rouran was afraid and fled far away.

sentences.zh: 三月，搜於河西。

translations.literal: In the third month he conducted a battue hunt in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he conducted a battue hunt in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day bingshen in the fourth month of summer there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the first day of the fourth summer month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 九月，閱武於磧上，遂北伐。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he reviewed troops on the desert and then campaigned north.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he reviewed troops on the desert and then campaigned north.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，皇太子及群官奉迎於行宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the tenth month of winter the crown prince and the officials welcomed him at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the tenth winter month the crown prince and the officials welcomed him at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，車駕至自北伐。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the twelfth month the imperial carriage returned from the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the twelfth month the emperor returned from the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以平昌公托真為中山王。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou Duke of Pingchang Tuozhen was made Prince of Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Duke of Pingchang Tuozhen was made Prince of Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月乙丑，行幸洛陽。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, spring, first month, on the day yichou, he traveled in state to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the eleventh year, on yichou in the first month, he traveled in state to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 所過郡國，皆親對高年，存恤孤寡。

translations.literal: In every commandery and kingdom he passed he personally addressed the aged and comforted orphans and widows.
translations.idiomatic: In every commandery and kingdom he passed he personally addressed the aged and comforted orphans and widows.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，大搜於梁山。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the second month a great battue hunt was held at Liangshan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the second month a great battue hunt was held at Liangshan.

sentences.zh: 皇子真薨。

translations.literal: Prince Zhen died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhen died.

sentences.zh: 是月，大修宮室，皇太子居於北宮。

translations.literal: That month the palace buildings were greatly repaired; the crown prince resided in the Northern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: That month the palace buildings were greatly repaired; the crown prince resided in the Northern Palace.

sentences.zh: 車駕遂征懸瓠。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage then campaigned against Xuanhu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then campaigned against Xuanhu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，車駕還宮，賜從者及留臺郎吏已上生口各有差。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the fourth month of summer the imperial carriage returned to the palace and granted captives to followers and to clerks of the capital staff and above, each according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the fourth summer month the emperor returned to the palace and granted captives to followers and to clerks of the capital staff and above, each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，誅司徒崔浩。

translations.literal: On the day jihai Minister of Education Cui Hao was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Minister of Education Cui Hao was executed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，北巡陰山。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou he toured north to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he toured north to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，宋將王玄謨攻滑臺。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn the Song general Wang Xuanmo attacked Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the Song general Wang Xuanmo attacked Huatai.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，田於河田。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the eighth month he hunted at Hetian.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the eighth month he hunted at Hetian.

sentences.zh: 癸未，練兵於西郊。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei he drilled troops at the western suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he drilled troops at the western suburb.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，車駕南伐。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao in the ninth month the imperial carriage campaigned south.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the ninth month the emperor campaigned south.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，皇太子北伐，屯於漠南。

translations.literal: On the day guisi the crown prince campaigned north and encamped south of the desert.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the crown prince campaigned north and encamped south of the desert.

sentences.zh: 吳王余留守京都。

translations.literal: Prince of Wu Yu remained to guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Wu Yu remained to guard the capital.

sentences.zh: 庚子，曲赦定、冀、相三州死罪已下。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi a partial amnesty was proclaimed for capital crimes and below in the three provinces of Ding, Ji, and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi a partial amnesty was proclaimed for capital crimes and below in the three provinces of Ding, Ji, and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙丑，車駕濟河，玄謨棄軍而走，乃命諸將分道並進。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the tenth month of winter the imperial carriage crossed the river; Xuanmo abandoned his army and fled; the Emperor then ordered the generals to advance in separate columns.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the tenth winter month the emperor crossed the river; Xuanmo abandoned his army and fled; he then ordered the generals to advance in separate columns.

sentences.zh: 車駕自中道。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage took the central route.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took the central route.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，至鄒山。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao in the eleventh month he reached Zou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the eleventh month he reached Zou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 使使者以太牢祀孔子。

translations.literal: He dispatched envoys to sacrifice to Confucius with the great offering.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched envoys to sacrifice to Confucius with the great offering.

sentences.zh: 是月，頞盾國獻師子一。

translations.literal: That month the kingdom of Yedun presented one lion.
translations.idiomatic: That month the kingdom of Yedun presented one lion.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，車駕至淮。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the twelfth month the imperial carriage reached the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the twelfth month the emperor reached the Huai.

sentences.zh: 詔刈雚葦作筏數萬而濟，淮南皆降。

translations.literal: An edict ordered reaping rushes and reeds to make tens of thousands of rafts for crossing; all south of the Huai surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered reaping rushes and reeds to make tens of thousands of rafts for crossing; all south of the Huai surrendered.

sentences.zh: 癸未，車駕臨江，起行宮於瓜步山。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei the imperial carriage came to the river and raised a traveling palace on Guabu Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the emperor came to the river and raised a traveling palace on Guabu Mountain.

sentences.zh: 諸軍同日皆臨江，所過城邑，莫不望塵奔潰，其降附者不可勝數。

translations.literal: On the same day all armies came to the river; every city and town they passed fled at the sight of dust without fighting; those who surrendered were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: On the same day all armies came to the river; every city and town they passed fled at the sight of dust without fighting; those who surrendered were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 甲申，宋文帝使獻百牢，貢其方物，又請進女於皇孫，以求和好。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Emperor Wen of Song sent envoys presenting a hundred sets of sacrificial beasts, tribute of local products, and also requesting to send a daughter to the imperial grandson to seek peace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Emperor Wen of Song sent envoys presenting a hundred sets of sacrificial beasts, tribute of local products, and also requesting to send a daughter to the imperial grandson to seek peace.

sentences.zh: 帝以師婚非禮，許和而不許婚，使散騎侍即夏侯野報之。

translations.literal: The Emperor held that military marriage was not proper ritual; he permitted peace but not marriage, and sent Palace Attendant Xiahou Ye to reply.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held that military marriage was not proper ritual; he permitted peace but not marriage, and sent Palace Attendant Xiahou Ye to reply.

sentences.zh: 帝詔皇孫為書，致馬通問焉。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered the imperial grandson to write a letter and send horses to open communications.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the imperial grandson to write a letter and send horses to open communications.

sentences.zh: 正平元年春正月丙戌朔，大會郡臣於江上，文武受爵者二百餘人。

translations.literal: On the first day bingxu in the first month of spring of the first year of Zhengping a great assembly of commandery ministers was held on the river; more than two hundred civil and military officials received ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the first day of the first spring month of Zhengping year one, a great assembly of commandery ministers was held on the river; more than two hundred civil and military officials received ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，車駕北旋。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai the imperial carriage turned north.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor turned north.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，次於魯口。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the second month he halted at Lukou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the second month he halted at Lukou.

sentences.zh: 皇太子朝於行宮。

translations.literal: The crown prince attended court at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince attended court at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 三月己亥，車駕至自南伐，飲至策勛，告於宗廟，以降人五萬餘家分置近畿，賜留臺文武所獲軍資生口各有差。

translations.literal: On the day jihai in the third month the imperial carriage returned from the southern campaign, held a drinking ceremony to distribute rewards, reported to the ancestral temple, assigned more than fifty thousand surrendered families to the near capital districts, and granted military supplies and captives taken by the capital staff to civil and military officials according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the third month the emperor returned from the southern campaign, held a drinking ceremony to distribute rewards, reported to the ancestral temple, assigned more than fifty thousand surrendered families to the near capital districts, and granted military supplies and captives taken by the capital staff to civil and military officials according to rank.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬寅，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the fifth month of summer a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the fifth summer month a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，改元。

translations.literal: On the day renxu in the sixth month the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the sixth month the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 車師國王遣子入侍。

translations.literal: The king of Cheshi sent his son to attend court.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Cheshi sent his son to attend court.

sentences.zh: 詔以刑綱太密，犯者更眾，命有司其案律令，務求厥中，自余有不便於人者，依比增損。

translations.literal: An edict said that because the penal code was too dense and offenders grew ever more numerous, the officials were ordered to examine the statutes and ordinances, striving for the mean; as for the rest that were inconvenient for the people, they were to be increased or reduced by comparison.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said that because the penal code was too dense and offenders grew ever more numerous, the officials were ordered to examine the statutes and ordinances, striving for the mean; as for the rest that were inconvenient for the people, they were to be increased or reduced by comparison.

sentences.zh: 詔太子少傅遊雅、中書侍郎胡方回等改定律制。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince You Ya, Secretariat Gentleman Hu Fanghui, and others to revise the laws and regulations.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince You Ya, Secretariat Gentleman Hu Fanghui, and others to revise the laws and regulations.

sentences.zh: 略陽王羯兒、高涼王那有罪賜死。

translations.literal: Prince of Lueyang Jie'er and Prince of Gaoliang Na, guilty of crimes, were granted death.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Lueyang Jie'er and Prince of Gaoliang Na, guilty of crimes, were granted death.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，皇太子薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen the crown prince died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the crown prince died.

sentences.zh: 壬申，葬景穆太子於金陵。

translations.literal: On the day renshen the Jingmu crown prince was buried at Jinling.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the Jingmu crown prince was buried at Jinling.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the seventh month of autumn he traveled in state to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the seventh autumn month he traveled in state to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 省諸曹吏員三分之一。

translations.literal: The staff of the various bureaus was reduced by one third.
translations.idiomatic: The staff of the various bureaus was reduced by one third.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the ninth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the ninth month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the tenth month of winter he traveled in state to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the tenth winter month he traveled in state to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 宋人來聘。

translations.literal: Envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.

sentences.zh: 詔殿中將軍郎法佑使於宋。

translations.literal: An edict ordered General of the Palace Lang Fayou as envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered General of the Palace Lang Fayou as envoy to Song.

sentences.zh: 己巳，司空、上黨王長孫道生薨。

translations.literal: On the day jisi Minister of Works Prince of Shangdang Changsun Daosheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Minister of Works Prince of Shangdang Changsun Daosheng died.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou in the twelfth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the twelfth month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 封皇孫浚為高陽王，尋以皇孫世嫡，不宜在籓，乃止。

translations.literal: The imperial grandson Jun was enfeoffed as Prince of Gaoyang; soon, because as heir of the imperial line he ought not to hold a feudatory domain, this was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial grandson Jun was enfeoffed as Prince of Gaoyang; soon, because as heir of the imperial line he ought not to hold a feudatory domain, this was stopped.

sentences.zh: 改封秦王翰為東平王，燕王譚為臨淮王，楚王建為廣陽王，吳王余為南安王。

translations.literal: Prince of Qin Han was changed to Prince of Dongping, Prince of Yan Tan to Prince of Linhuai, Prince of Chu Jian to Prince of Guangyang, and Prince of Wu Yu to Prince of Nan'an.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qin Han was changed to Prince of Dongping, Prince of Yan Tan to Prince of Linhuai, Prince of Chu Jian to Prince of Guangyang, and Prince of Wu Yu to Prince of Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月庚辰朔，南來降人五千餘家於中山謀叛，州軍討平之。

translations.literal: On the first day gengchen in the first month of spring of the second year more than five thousand families of southerners who had surrendered plotted rebellion at Zhongshan; provincial troops suppressed them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the first day of the first spring month of the second year, more than five thousand families of southerners who had surrendered plotted rebellion at Zhongshan; provincial troops suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 冀州刺史、張掖王沮渠萬年與降人通謀，賜死。

translations.literal: Governor of Jizhou Prince of Zhangye Juqu Wannian conspired with the surrendered people and was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Jizhou Prince of Zhangye Juqu Wannian conspired with the surrendered people and was granted death.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，中常侍宗愛構逆，帝崩於永安宮，時年四十五。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the third month the Palace Attendant Zong Ai plotted treason; the Emperor died at Yong'an Palace, aged forty-five.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the third month the Palace Attendant Zong Ai plotted treason; the emperor died at Yong'an Palace, aged forty-five.

sentences.zh: 秘不發喪。

translations.literal: The death was kept secret and no mourning was announced.
translations.idiomatic: The death was kept secret and no mourning was announced.

sentences.zh: 愛又矯皇后令，殺東平王翰，迎周安王余立。

translations.literal: Ai also forged an order of the empress to kill Prince of Dongping Han, welcome Prince of Zhou'an Yu, and install him.
translations.idiomatic: Ai also forged an order of the empress to kill Prince of Dongping Han, welcome Prince of Zhou'an Yu, and install him.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元為永平。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: A great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Yongping.

sentences.zh: 尊謚曰太武皇帝，葬於雲中金陵，廟號世祖。

translations.literal: The posthumous title Grand Martial Emperor was honored; he was buried at Jinling in Yunzhong; the temple name was Shizu.
translations.idiomatic: The posthumous title Grand Martial Emperor was honored; he was buried at Jinling in Yunzhong; the temple name was Shizu.

sentences.zh: 帝生不逮密太后，及有所識，言則悲慟，哀感傍人，明元聞而嘉嘆。

translations.literal: The Emperor had never known the Secret Empress Dowager in life; when he came to recognize her, he spoke with grief and wept, moving those beside him; Emperor Mingyuan heard of it and praised and sighed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had never known the Secret Empress Dowager in life; when he came to recognize her, he spoke with grief and wept, moving those beside him; Emperor Mingyuan heard of it and praised and sighed.

sentences.zh: 及明元不豫，衣不釋帶。

translations.literal: When Emperor Mingyuan was ill he did not remove his belt.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Mingyuan was ill he did not remove his belt.

sentences.zh: 性清儉率素，服御飲膳，取給而已，不好珍麗，食不二味。

translations.literal: By nature he was pure, frugal, and plain; in dress, carriage, food, and drink he took only what sufficed; he did not love splendor; he did not eat two flavors at once.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he was pure, frugal, and plain; in dress, carriage, food, and drink he took only what sufficed; he did not love splendor; he did not eat two flavors at once.

sentences.zh: 所幸昭儀、貴人，衣無兼彩。

translations.literal: The Brilliant Consort and Honored Lady whom he favored wore no garment of more than one color.
translations.idiomatic: The Brilliant Consort and Honored Lady whom he favored wore no garment of more than one color.

sentences.zh: 群臣白帝，更峻京邑城隍以從《周易》設險之義，又陳蕭何壯麗之說。

translations.literal: The ministers reported to the Emperor that the capital walls should be made steeper to follow the meaning of the Book of Changes in setting defenses, and also cited Xiao He's argument for magnificence.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers reported to the emperor that the capital walls should be made steeper to follow the meaning of the Book of Changes in setting defenses, and also cited Xiao He's argument for magnificence.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「古人有言，在德不在險。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "The ancients had a saying: it lies in virtue, not in defenses.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The ancients had a saying: it lies in virtue, not in defenses.

sentences.zh: 屈丐蒸土築城，而朕滅之，豈在城也？

translations.literal: Juqu steamed earth to build a city, yet We destroyed him—was it in the walls?
translations.idiomatic: Juqu steamed earth to build a city, yet We destroyed him—was it in the walls?

sentences.zh: 今天下未平，方須人力，土功之事，朕所未為。

translations.literal: Now the realm is not yet pacified and men are still needed; earthworks We have not undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: Now the realm is not yet pacified and men are still needed; earthworks We have not undertaken.

sentences.zh: 蕭何之對，非雅言也。

translations.literal: Xiao He's reply was not elegant speech."
translations.idiomatic: Xiao He's reply was not elegant speech."

sentences.zh: 」每以財者軍國之本，無所輕費。

translations.literal: He always held wealth to be the root of army and state and was never lightly extravagant.
translations.idiomatic: He always held wealth to be the root of army and state and was never lightly extravagant.

sentences.zh: 至於賞賜，皆是勛績之家，親戚愛寵，未嘗橫有所及。

translations.literal: As for rewards and gifts, they went only to families of merit; kin and favorites were never granted anything without cause.
translations.idiomatic: As for rewards and gifts, they went only to families of merit; kin and favorites were never granted anything without cause.

sentences.zh: 臨敵，常與士卒同在矢石間。

translations.literal: Facing the enemy he was always amid the arrows and stones with the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Facing the enemy he was always amid the arrows and stones with the soldiers.

sentences.zh: 左右死傷者相繼，而帝神色自若。

translations.literal: Those beside him were wounded and killed one after another, yet the Emperor's expression remained calm.
translations.idiomatic: Those beside him were wounded and killed one after another, yet the emperor's expression remained calm.

sentences.zh: 是以人思效命，所向無前。

translations.literal: Therefore men wished to give their lives; wherever he went there was none before him.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore men wished to give their lives; wherever he went there was none before him.

sentences.zh: 命將出師，指授節度，從命者無不制勝，違爽者率多敗失。

translations.literal: When he ordered generals to take the field he personally directed their dispositions; those who obeyed were never without victory, those who deviated mostly met defeat.
translations.idiomatic: When he ordered generals to take the field he personally directed their dispositions; those who obeyed were never without victory, those who deviated mostly met defeat.

sentences.zh: 性又知人。

translations.literal: By nature he also knew men well.
translations.idiomatic: By nature he also knew men well.

sentences.zh: 拔士於卒伍之中，唯其才效所長。

translations.literal: He raised men from the ranks, using only their talents and achievements.
translations.idiomatic: He raised men from the ranks, using only their talents and achievements.

sentences.zh: 不論本末，兼甚嚴斷，明於刑賞。

translations.literal: He did not weigh origin against accomplishment, yet was very stern and decisive, clear in punishments and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: He did not weigh origin against accomplishment, yet was very stern and decisive, clear in punishments and rewards.

sentences.zh: 功者賞不遺賤，罪者刑不避親，雖寵愛之，終不虧法。

translations.literal: The meritorious were rewarded without overlooking the lowly; the guilty were punished without sparing kin; even those he favored were never exempt from the law.
translations.idiomatic: The meritorious were rewarded without overlooking the lowly; the guilty were punished without sparing kin; even those he favored were never exempt from the law.

sentences.zh: 常曰：「法者，朕與天下共之，何敢輕也。

translations.literal: He often said: "The law is what We share with the realm—how dare We treat it lightly?"
translations.idiomatic: He often said: "The law is what We share with the realm—how dare We treat it lightly?"

sentences.zh: 」故大臣犯法，無所寬假。

translations.literal: Therefore when great ministers violated the law there was no leniency.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore when great ministers violated the law there was no leniency.

sentences.zh: 雅長聽察，瞬息之間，下無以措其奸隱。

translations.literal: He excelled at listening and observing; in the space of a breath those below could not hide their treachery.
translations.idiomatic: He excelled at listening and observing; in the space of a breath those below could not hide their treachery.

sentences.zh: 然果於誅戮，後多悔之。

translations.literal: Yet he was quick to execute and afterward often regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was quick to execute and afterward often regretted it.

sentences.zh: 司徒崔浩死後，帝北伐，時宣城公李孝伯疾篤，傳者以為卒，帝聞而悼之，謂左右曰：「李宣城可惜。

translations.literal: After Minister of Education Cui Hao died, during the northern campaign Duke of Xuancheng Li Xiaobo was gravely ill; rumor said he had died; the Emperor heard and mourned him, saying to those beside him: "Li of Xuancheng is to be regretted."
translations.idiomatic: After Minister of Education Cui Hao died, during the northern campaign Duke of Xuancheng Li Xiaobo was gravely ill; rumor said he had died; the emperor heard and mourned him, saying to those beside him: "Li of Xuancheng is to be regretted."

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「朕向失言，崔司徒可惜，李宣城可哀。

translations.literal: He also said: "We spoke wrongly before—Minister Cui is to be regretted; Li of Xuancheng is to be pitied."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "We spoke wrongly before—Minister Cui is to be regretted; Li of Xuancheng is to be pitied."

sentences.zh: 」褒貶雅意，皆此類也。

translations.literal: His praise and blame in elegant intent were all of this kind.
translations.idiomatic: His praise and blame in elegant intent were all of this kind.

sentences.zh: 景穆皇帝諱晃，太武皇帝之長子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Jingmu, taboo name Huang, was the eldest son of Emperor Taiwu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jingmu, taboo name Huang, was the eldest son of Emperor Taiwu.

sentences.zh: 母曰賀夫人。

translations.literal: His mother was Lady He.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Lady He.

sentences.zh: 延和元年正月丙午，立為皇太子，時年五歲。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yanhe, first month, on the day bingwu, he was installed as crown prince, aged five.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Yanhe, on bingwu in the first month, he was installed as crown prince, aged five.

sentences.zh: 明慧強識，聞則不忘。

translations.literal: Bright and keen in memory, he heard once and did not forget.
translations.idiomatic: Bright and keen in memory, he heard once and did not forget.

sentences.zh: 及長，好讀經史，皆通大義。

translations.literal: When grown he loved reading the classics and histories and mastered their great principles.
translations.idiomatic: When grown he loved reading the classics and histories and mastered their great principles.

sentences.zh: 太武甚奇之。

translations.literal: Emperor Taiwu greatly marveled at him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taiwu greatly marveled at him.

sentences.zh: 及西征涼州，皇太子監國。

translations.literal: When the western campaign against Liangzhou was undertaken, the crown prince supervised the state.
translations.idiomatic: When the western campaign against Liangzhou was undertaken, the crown prince supervised the state.

sentences.zh: 初，太武之伐河西，李順等咸言姑臧無水草，不可行師。

translations.literal: At first, when Emperor Taiwu attacked Hexi, Li Shun and others all said Guzang had no water or grass and troops could not march.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Emperor Taiwu attacked Hexi, Li Shun and others all said Guzang had no water or grass and troops could not march.

sentences.zh: 太子有疑色。

translations.literal: The crown prince showed a doubtful expression.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince showed a doubtful expression.

sentences.zh: 及車駕至姑臧，乃詔太子曰：「姑臧城東西門外湧泉，合於城北，其大如河，澤草茂盛，可供大軍數年。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage reached Guzang, he then sent word to the crown prince: "East and west of Guzang city springs gush forth and join north of the city; they are as large as a river; marsh grass is lush and can supply a great army for several years.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor reached Guzang, he then sent word to the crown prince: "East and west of Guzang city springs gush forth and join north of the city; they are as large as a river; marsh grass is lush and can supply a great army for several years.

sentences.zh: 人之多言，亦可惡也。

translations.literal: Much that men say is also to be detested."
translations.idiomatic: Much that men say is also to be detested."

sentences.zh: 」太子謂宮臣曰：「為人臣不實若此，豈是忠乎！

translations.literal: The crown prince told the palace officials: "To be a minister so untruthful—how is this loyalty!
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince told the palace officials: "To be a minister so untruthful—how is this loyalty!

sentences.zh: 吾初聞有疑，但帝決行耳。

translations.literal: When I first heard it I had doubts, but the Emperor had already decided to march.
translations.idiomatic: When I first heard it I had doubts, but the emperor had already decided to march.

sentences.zh: 幾誤人大事，言者復何面目見帝也。」

translations.literal: They nearly ruined a great affair—how can such speakers show their faces before the Emperor?"
translations.idiomatic: They nearly ruined a great affair—how can such speakers show their faces before the emperor?"

sentences.zh: 真君四年，從征蠕蠕，至鹿渾谷，與賊遇。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhenjun he followed the campaign against the Rouran; reaching Luhun Valley they met the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Zhenjun he followed the campaign against the Rouran; reaching Luhun Valley they met the enemy.

sentences.zh: 虜惶怖擾亂。

translations.literal: The barbarians were fearful and in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: The barbarians were fearful and in disorder.

sentences.zh: 太子言於太武曰：「宜速進擊，掩其不備。

translations.literal: The crown prince said to Emperor Taiwu: "We should advance swiftly and strike while they are unprepared."
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince said to Emperor Taiwu: "We should advance swiftly and strike while they are unprepared."

sentences.zh: 」尚書令劉潔固諫，以為塵盛賊多，須軍大集。

translations.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Jie firmly remonstrated, holding that the dust was thick and the enemy numerous and the main force must assemble first.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Masters of Writing Liu Jie firmly remonstrated, holding that the dust was thick and the enemy numerous and the main force must assemble first.

sentences.zh: 太子曰：「此由賊恇擾，何有營上而有此塵？

translations.literal: The crown prince said: "This comes from the enemy's panic—how could there be such dust above a camp?"
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince said: "This comes from the enemy's panic—how could there be such dust above a camp?"

sentences.zh: 」太武疑之，遂不急擊，蠕蠕遠遁。

translations.literal: Emperor Taiwu was doubtful and therefore did not press the attack swiftly; the Rouran fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taiwu was doubtful and therefore did not press the attack swiftly; the Rouran fled far away.

sentences.zh: 既而獲虜候騎，乃雲不覺官軍卒至，上下惶懼。

translations.literal: Afterward captured barbarian scouts reported that they had not noticed the royal army arriving suddenly and that high and low were all fearful.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward captured barbarian scouts reported that they had not noticed the royal army arriving suddenly and that high and low were all fearful.

sentences.zh: 北走經六七日，知無追者，乃徐行。

translations.literal: They fled north for six or seven days; learning there was no pursuit, they marched slowly.
translations.idiomatic: They fled north for six or seven days; learning there was no pursuit, they marched slowly.

sentences.zh: 帝深恨之。

translations.literal: The Emperor deeply regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply regretted it.

sentences.zh: 自是太子所言軍國大事，多見納用，遂知萬機。

translations.literal: From then on what the crown prince said on great matters of army and state was mostly adopted, and he came to know the myriad affairs.
translations.idiomatic: From then on what the crown prince said on great matters of army and state was mostly adopted, and he came to know the myriad affairs.

sentences.zh: 及監國，命有司使百姓有牛家以人牛相貿。

translations.literal: When supervising the state he ordered the officials to have households with cattle trade men for cattle.
translations.idiomatic: When supervising the state he ordered the officials to have households with cattle trade men for cattle.

sentences.zh: 又禁飲酒雜戲棄本沽販者，於是墾田大增。

translations.literal: He also forbade drinking, mixed entertainments, abandoning the root for petty trade, and thereby plowing of fields greatly increased.
translations.idiomatic: He also forbade drinking, mixed entertainments, abandoning the root for petty trade, and thereby plowing of fields greatly increased.

sentences.zh: 正平元年六月戊辰，薨於東宮，時年二十四。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen in the sixth month of the first year of Zhengping he died in the Eastern Palace, aged twenty-four.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the sixth month of Zhengping year one he died in the Eastern Palace, aged twenty-four.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命持節兼太尉張黎、兼司空竇瑾奉策即柩謚景穆太子。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu he ordered Bearer of the Staff Concurrent Grand Commandant Zhang Li and Concurrent Minister of Works Dou Jin to present the posthumous title Jingmu crown prince by the coffin with the imperial staff.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he ordered Bearer of the Staff Concurrent Grand Commandant Zhang Li and Concurrent Minister of Works Dou Jin to present the posthumous title Jingmu crown prince by the coffin with the imperial staff.

sentences.zh: 文成即位，追尊為景穆皇帝，廟號恭宗。

translations.literal: When Wencheng acceded he was posthumously honored as Emperor Jingmu; temple name Gongzong.
translations.idiomatic: When Wencheng acceded he was posthumously honored as Emperor Jingmu; temple name Gongzong.

sentences.zh: 高宗文成皇帝諱浚，景穆皇帝之長子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Wencheng, taboo name Jun, was the eldest son of Emperor Jingmu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wencheng, taboo name Jun, was the eldest son of Emperor Jingmu.

sentences.zh: 母曰閭氏。

translations.literal: His mother was the Lady Lu.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was the Lady Lu.

sentences.zh: 真君元年六月，生於東宮。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the first year of Zhenjun he was born in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Zhenjun year one he was born in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 帝少聰達，太武常置左右，號世嫡皇孫。

translations.literal: As a child he was quick and penetrating; Emperor Taiwu often kept him at his side and styled him heir of the imperial line.
translations.idiomatic: As a child he was quick and penetrating; Emperor Taiwu often kept him at his side and styled him heir of the imperial line.

sentences.zh: 年五歲，太武北巡，帝從在後，逢虜帥桎一奴，將加罰。

translations.literal: At age five, when Emperor Taiwu toured the north, the Emperor followed behind; they met a barbarian chief shackling a slave and about to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: At age five, when Emperor Taiwu toured the north, the boy followed behind; they met a barbarian chief shackling a slave and about to punish him.

sentences.zh: 帝謂曰：「奴今遭我，汝宜釋之。

translations.literal: The Emperor said to him: "The slave has now met Us—you should release him."
translations.idiomatic: The boy said to him: "The slave has now met me—you should release him."

sentences.zh: 」帥奉命解縛。

translations.literal: The chief obeyed the command and untied him.
translations.idiomatic: The chief obeyed the command and untied him.

translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the first day of the tenth month, he also murdered Yu.

translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Director of the Palace Secretariat Changsun Kehou of the palace interior and Director of the Masters of Writing Lu Li welcomed the heir of the imperial line.

sentences.zh: 興安元年冬十月戊申，皇帝即位於永安前殿。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter of the first year of Xing'an, on the day wushen, the Emperor took the throne in the front hall of Yong'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the tenth winter month of Xing'an year one the emperor took the throne in the front hall of Yong'an.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元，正平二年為興安。

translations.idiomatic: A great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed; the second year of Zhengping became Xing'an.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛巳，進司空杜元寶爵為京兆王。

translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the first spring month of the second year Minister of Works Du Yuanbao was advanced in rank to Prince of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 廣平王杜遺薨。

translations.literal: Prince of Guangping Du Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Guangping Du Yi died.

sentences.zh: 進尚書僕射、東安公劉尼爵為王。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Duke of Dong'an Liu Ni was advanced in rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Duke of Dong'an Liu Ni was advanced in rank to prince.

sentences.zh: 封建寧王崇子麗為濟南王。

translations.idiomatic: Li, son of Prince of Jianning Chong, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinan.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔與百姓雜調十五。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei an edict levied a miscellaneous tax of fifteen on the people.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei an edict levied a miscellaneous tax of fifteen on the people.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，進尚書、西平公源賀爵為王。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu Director of the Masters of Writing Duke of Xiping Yuan He was advanced in rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Director of the Masters of Writing Duke of Xiping Yuan He was advanced in rank to prince.

sentences.zh: 二月己未，司空、京兆王杜元寶謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the second month Minister of Works Prince of Jingzhao Du Yuanbao plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the second month Minister of Works Prince of Jingzhao Du Yuanbao plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 建寧王崇、崇子濟南王麗為元寶所引，各賜死。

translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jianning Chong and his son Prince of Jinan Li, drawn in by Yuanbao, were each granted death.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，發京師五千人穿天泉池。

translations.literal: On the day yichou five thousand men were mobilized from the capital to dig the Tianquan Pool.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou five thousand men were mobilized from the capital to dig the Tianquan Pool.

sentences.zh: 是月，宋太子劭殺文帝。

translations.literal: That month Crown Prince Shao of Song killed Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: That month Crown Prince Shao of Song killed Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 三月，尊保太后為皇太后。

translations.literal: In the third month Empress Dowager Bao was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Empress Dowager Bao was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 進安豐公閭武皮爵為河間王。

translations.literal: Duke of Anfeng Lu Wupi was advanced in rank to Prince of Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Anfeng Lu Wupi was advanced in rank to Prince of Hejian.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，宋孝武帝殺太子劭而自立。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer Emperor Xiaowu of Song killed Crown Prince Shao and installed himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth summer month Emperor Xiaowu of Song killed Crown Prince Shao and installed himself.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙亥，太皇太后赫連氏崩。

translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the intercalary month Grand Empress Dowager Lady Helian died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the seventh month of autumn he traveled in state to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the seventh autumn month he traveled in state to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 濮陽王閭若文、永昌王仁謀反。

translations.idiomatic: Prince of Puyang Lu Ruowen and Prince of Yongchang Ren plotted rebellion.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，仁賜死，若文伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day yimao Ren was granted death and Ruowen was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Ren was granted death and Ruowen was executed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day jisi the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the emperor returned to the palace.

translations.literal: That month an archery platform was built at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: That month an archery platform was built at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，詔曰：「朕即位以來，風雨順序，邊方無事，眾瑞兼呈。

translations.idiomatic: Again within the park a square-inch jade seal was obtained, inscribed: "Descendants long life."

translations.literal: The dukes, ministers, and grandees all said it was glorious—could We alone have attained such responses? It is truly because Heaven, Earth, and the ancestors have sent down their blessing.
translations.idiomatic: The dukes, ministers, and grandees all said it was glorious—could We alone have attained such responses? It is truly because Heaven, Earth, and the ancestors have sent down their blessing.

translations.idiomatic: We wish to share this fine celebration with the myriad people.

translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the ninth month troops were reviewed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛酉，行幸信都、中山，觀察風俗。

translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the eleventh winter month he traveled in state to Xindu and Zhongshan to observe local customs.

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the twelfth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the twelfth month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 復北平公長孫敦王爵。

translations.literal: Duke of Beiping Changsun Dun's princely rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Beiping Changsun Dun's princely rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 是歲，疏勒、渴盤陀、庫莫奚、契丹、罽賓等國各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Kashgar, Khotan, the Kumoxi, the Khitan, and Kapisa and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Kashgar, Khotan, the Kumoxi, the Khitan, and Kapisa and other states each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 興光元年春正月乙丑，以侍中、河南公伊珝為司空。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xingguang, first month of spring, on the day yichou, Palace Attendant Duke of Henan Yi Yu was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Xingguang year one, on yichou in the first month, Palace Attendant Duke of Henan Yi Yu was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午，帝至道壇，登受圖箓。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the second month the Emperor came to the Dao altar and ascended to receive the charts and tallies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the second month the emperor came to the Dao altar and ascended to receive the charts and tallies.

sentences.zh: 禮華，曲赦京師。

translations.literal: Rites were performed to Hua; a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Rites were performed to Hua; a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏六月，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer he traveled in state to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth summer month he traveled in state to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day bingshen in the seventh month of autumn there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the first day of the seventh autumn month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

translations.literal: On the day gengzi Prince Hong was born.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Prince Hong was born.

translations.literal: On the day xinchou a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，趙王深薨。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu Prince of Zhao Shen died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Prince of Zhao Shen died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day yihai the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，皇叔武頭、龍頭薨。

translations.literal: On the day yichou the Emperor's uncles Wutou and Longtou died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the emperor's uncles Wutou and Longtou died.

translations.idiomatic: The capital gates were closed and a great search lasted three days; several hundred traitors and fugitives were captured.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊戌，行幸中山，遂幸信都。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the eleventh month of winter he traveled in state to Zhongshan and then visited Xindu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the eleventh winter month he traveled in state to Zhongshan and then visited Xindu.

translations.literal: On the day bingzi he returned to visit Lingqiu and reached the Hot Springs Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he returned to visit Lingqiu and reached the Hot Springs Palace.

translations.literal: On the day gengchen the imperial carriage returned to the palace.

translations.idiomatic: The states of Chuyu, Chiwandan, and others each sent envoys with tribute.

translations.idiomatic: In spring of Tai'an year one, on xinyou in the first month, the spirit tablets of Taiwu and Jingmu were presented at the Grand Temple.

translations.idiomatic: Prince of Leping Ba, guilty of a crime, was granted death.

translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the second month Prince of Wuchang Ti died.

translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the third month the spirit tablets of Taiwu and Jingmu entered the Grand Temple; the era name was changed and a partial amnesty was proclaimed for capital prisoners below death.

translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the sixth summer month an edict named Prince Hong; a partial amnesty was proclaimed.

translations.idiomatic: On guiyou an edict ordered Director of the Masters of Writing Mu Zhen and twenty others to tour the provinces and commanderies, observe local customs, and clarify rewards and punishments.

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the tenth winter month Duke of Liaoxi Chang Ying was made Grand Preceptor and advanced in rank to prince.

translations.literal: That year Zheyi, Persia, Kashgar, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zheyi, Persia, Kashgar, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the second month Prince Hong was installed as crown prince; a great amnesty was proclaimed.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth summer month Cadet of the Feathered Forest Yu Pan, Yuan Ti, and others plotted treason and were executed.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，田於河西。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn he hunted in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month he hunted in Hexi.

translations.idiomatic: Pacifier of the West General Duke of Yuyang Yu Juan attacked Yiwu in the north, took its city, and returned with great booty.

translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the ninth month Duke of Hedong Lu Pi and Duke of Lingling Lu He were advanced in rank to princes.

translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the tenth winter month the emperor returned to the palace.

translations.idiomatic: On jiawu a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月，改封西平王源賀隴西王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Duke of Xiping Yuan He was changed to Prince of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Duke of Xiping Yuan He was changed to Prince of Longxi.

sentences.zh: 嚈噠、普嵐等國各遣使朝貢。

translations.idiomatic: The Hephthalites, Pulan, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月，征漁陽公尉眷拜太尉，進爵為王，錄尚書事。

translations.literal: In the third year, first month of spring, Pacifier of Yuyang Yu Juan was summoned and made Grand Commandant, advanced in rank to prince, and given charge of Masters of Writing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the third year, first month, Pacifier of Yuyang Yu Juan was summoned and made Grand Commandant, advanced in rank to prince, and given charge of Masters of Writing affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，封皇弟新成為陽平王。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer the Emperor's younger brother Xincheng was enfeoffed as Prince of Yangping.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth summer month the emperor's younger brother Xincheng was enfeoffed as Prince of Yangping.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the sixth month he traveled in state to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the sixth month he traveled in state to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，田於陰山之北。

translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month he hunted north of Yinshan.

translations.idiomatic: On jihai he returned to the palace.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, about to tour east, he ordered Grand Preceptor Chang Ying to raise a traveling palace at Huangshan in Liaoxi.

translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the first day of the first spring month of the fourth year, the wine prohibition was first established.

translations.idiomatic: On yimao he traveled in state to the Guangning Hot Springs Palace and then toured east.

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he reached Huangshan Palace in Liaoxi.

translations.idiomatic: Jieshi Mountain was renamed Mount of Joyful Touring and an altar was built on the seashore to record the journey.

translations.idiomatic: Every commandery and kingdom he passed was granted one year's tax remission.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 起太華殿。

translations.literal: The Taihua Hall was raised.
translations.idiomatic: The Taihua Hall was raised.

translations.literal: On the day yichou Prince of Dongping Lu Si died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Prince of Dongping Lu Si died.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬戌，詔曰：「比年以來，雜調減省，而所在州郡咸有逋懸。

translations.literal: On the day renxu in the fifth month of summer an edict said: "In recent years miscellaneous levies have been reduced, yet every province and commandery still has outstanding arrears.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the fifth summer month an edict said: "In recent years miscellaneous levies have been reduced, yet every province and commandery still has outstanding arrears.

sentences.zh: 非在職之官綏導失所，貪穢過度，誰使之然？

translations.literal: If it is not that officials in office have failed in guidance, or been greedy beyond measure—who has made it so?
translations.idiomatic: If it is not that officials in office have failed in guidance, or been greedy beyond measure—who has made it so?

sentences.zh: 自今常調不充，人不安業，宰人之徒，加以死罪。

translations.literal: From now on when the regular levy is not met and the people lack secure livelihood, those who govern shall additionally suffer the death penalty."
translations.idiomatic: From now on when the regular levy is not met and the people lack secure livelihood, those who govern shall additionally suffer the death penalty."

sentences.zh: 」六月丙申，田於松山。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the sixth month he hunted at Songshan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the sixth month he hunted at Songshan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，行幸河西。

translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the seventh autumn month he traveled in state to Hexi.

translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the ninth month he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太華殿成。
