translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Taihua Hall was completed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，饗群臣，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin he feasted the ministers and proclaimed a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he feasted the ministers and proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌，北巡，至陰山。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the tenth month of winter he toured north to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the tenth winter month he toured north to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 有故冢毀廢，詔曰：「昔姬文葬枯骨，天下歸仁。

translations.literal: There were old tombs destroyed; an edict said: "In antiquity King Wen of Zhou buried dry bones and the realm turned to him in benevolence.
translations.idiomatic: There were old tombs destroyed; an edict said: "In antiquity King Wen of Zhou buried dry bones and the realm turned to him in benevolence.

sentences.zh: 自今有穿墳壟者，斬之。」

translations.literal: From now on whoever breaks into tombs or mounds shall be beheaded."
translations.idiomatic: From now on whoever breaks into tombs or mounds shall be beheaded."

sentences.zh: 辛卯，次於車輪山，累石記行。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao he halted at Chelun Mountain and piled stones to record the journey.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he halted at Chelun Mountain and piled stones to record the journey.

sentences.zh: 十一月，車駕渡漠，蠕蠕絕跡遠遁。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the imperial carriage crossed the desert; the Rouran vanished without trace and fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the emperor crossed the desert; the Rouran vanished without trace and fled far away.

sentences.zh: 十二月，中山王托真薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Prince of Zhongshan Tuozhen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Prince of Zhongshan Tuozhen died.

sentences.zh: 有徙流者，喻還桑梓。

translations.literal: Those in exile or penal transport were instructed to return to their native districts.
translations.idiomatic: Those in exile or penal transport were instructed to return to their native districts.

sentences.zh: 十一月，詔散騎侍郎盧度世使於宋。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month an edict ordered Supernumerary Palace Attendant Lu Dushi as envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month an edict ordered Supernumerary Palace Attendant Lu Dushi as envoy to Song.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙酉，詔曰：「刺史牧人，為萬里之表。

translations.literal: In the second year, first month of spring, on the day yiyou, an edict said: "Provincial governors and pastoral officials are the model for ten thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year, on yiyou in the first month, an edict said: "Provincial governors and pastoral officials are the model for ten thousand li.

sentences.zh: 自頃每因發調，逼人假貸，大商富賈，要射時利，上下通同，分以潤屋。

translations.literal: Recently, whenever levies were issued, people were forced to borrow; great merchants and rich traders exploited the season for profit; high and low colluded and divided the gain to fill their houses.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, whenever levies were issued, people were forced to borrow; great merchants and rich traders exploited the season for profit; high and low colluded and divided the gain to fill their houses.

sentences.zh: 為政之弊，莫過於此，其一切禁絕。

translations.literal: No abuse of government surpasses this; let it all be forbidden and cut off.
translations.idiomatic: No abuse of government surpasses this; let it all be forbidden and cut off.

sentences.zh: 犯者，十疋以上皆死。

translations.literal: Violators, for ten bolts of cloth and above, all die.
translations.idiomatic: Violators, for ten bolts of cloth and above, all die.

sentences.zh: 布告天下，咸令知禁。

translations.literal: Proclaim throughout the realm and let all know the prohibition."
translations.idiomatic: Proclaim throughout the realm and let all know the prohibition."

sentences.zh: 」二月，行幸中山，遂幸信都。

translations.literal: In the second month he traveled in state to Zhongshan and then visited Xindu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month he traveled in state to Zhongshan and then visited Xindu.

sentences.zh: 三月，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: In the third month envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.

sentences.zh: 車駕所過，皆親對高年，問疾苦。

translations.literal: Wherever the imperial carriage passed he personally addressed the aged and asked after their hardships.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever the emperor passed he personally addressed the aged and asked after their hardships.

sentences.zh: 詔年八十，一子不從役。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that at age eighty one son was exempt from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that at age eighty one son was exempt from corvée.

sentences.zh: 靈丘南有山高四百餘丈，乃詔群臣仰射山峰，無能逾者。

translations.literal: South of Lingqiu was a mountain more than four hundred zhang high; the Emperor ordered the ministers to shoot upward at the peak; none could surpass it.
translations.idiomatic: South of Lingqiu was a mountain more than four hundred zhang high; the emperor ordered the ministers to shoot upward at the peak; none could surpass it.

sentences.zh: 帝彎弧發矢，出三十餘丈，過山南二百二十步。

translations.literal: The Emperor bent his bow and loosed an arrow that went out more than thirty zhang, passing two hundred twenty paces south of the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor bent his bow and loosed an arrow that went out more than thirty zhang, passing two hundred twenty paces south of the mountain.

sentences.zh: 遂刊石勒銘。

translations.literal: Thereupon stone was carved and an inscription cut.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon stone was carved and an inscription cut.

sentences.zh: 是月，發並、肆州五千餘人修河西獵道。

translations.literal: That month more than five thousand men from Bing and Xi provinces were mobilized to repair the hunting road in Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: That month more than five thousand men from Bing and Xi provinces were mobilized to repair the hunting road in Hexi.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，河東王閭毗薨。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the fourth month of summer Prince of Hedong Lu Pi died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the fourth summer month Prince of Hedong Lu Pi died.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，詔南部尚書黃盧頭、李敷業考課諸州。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the fifth month an edict ordered Director of the Southern Department Huang Lutou and Li Fuye to examine and grade the various provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the fifth month an edict ordered Director of the Southern Department Huang Lutou and Li Fuye to examine and grade the various provinces.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，封皇弟小新成為濟陰王，天賜為汝陰王，萬壽為樂良王，洛侯為廣平王。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the seventh month of autumn the Emperor's younger brothers Xiaoxincheng, Tianci, Wanshou, and Luohou were enfeoffed as princes of Jiyin, Ruyin, Lelang, and Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the seventh autumn month the emperor's younger brothers Xiaoxincheng, Tianci, Wanshou, and Luohou were enfeoffed as princes of Jiyin, Ruyin, Lelang, and Guangping.

sentences.zh: 四年春三月乙未，賜京師人年七十以上太官廚食，以終其年。

translations.literal: In the third month of spring of the fourth year, on the day yiwei, those in the capital aged seventy and above were granted food from the Imperial Kitchen for the rest of their years.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the third spring month of the fourth year those in the capital aged seventy and above were granted food from the Imperial Kitchen for the rest of their years.

sentences.zh: 皇子胡仁薨，追封樂陵王。

translations.literal: Prince Huren died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Leling.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Huren died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Leling.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，上幸西苑，親射猛獸三頭。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the fourth month of summer the Emperor visited the Western Park and personally shot three fierce beasts.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the fourth summer month the emperor visited the Western Park and personally shot three fierce beasts.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，侍中、漁陽王尉眷薨。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the fifth month Palace Attendant Prince of Yuyang Yu Juan died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the fifth month Palace Attendant Prince of Yuyang Yu Juan died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，行幸陰山。

translations.literal: On the day renyin he traveled in state to Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he traveled in state to Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，詔曰：「朕每歲閑月，命群臣講武。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the seventh month of autumn an edict said: "Each year in the idle months We order the ministers to lecture on martial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the seventh autumn month an edict said: "Each year in the idle months We order the ministers to lecture on martial affairs.

sentences.zh: 所幸之處，必立宮壇。

translations.literal: Wherever We go We always erect palace altars.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever We go We always erect palace altars.

sentences.zh: 糜費之功，勞損非一，宜仍舊費，何必改作也。

translations.idiomatic: The cost in waste and the labor in wear are not slight; the old expense should suffice—why must We rebuild?"

translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the eighth month he then hunted in Hexi.

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the ninth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the ninth month the emperor returned to the palace.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, because Ding and Xiang provinces suffered frost that harmed the crops, their field tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 詔員外散騎常侍遊明根使於宋。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Supernumerary Palace Attendant You Minggen as envoy to Song.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Supernumerary Palace Attendant You Minggen as envoy to Song.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，詔以喪葬嫁娶，大禮未備，命有司為之條格，使貴賤有章，上下咸序，著之於今。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the twelfth month an edict said that because funeral, burial, marriage, and great rites were not yet complete, the officials were ordered to draft regulations so noble and base had clear ranks and high and low were in order, to be recorded for the present.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the twelfth month an edict said that because funeral, burial, marriage, and great rites were not yet complete, the officials were ordered to draft regulations so noble and base had clear ranks and high and low were in order, to be recorded for the present.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔曰：「婚姻者，人道之始。

translations.literal: On the day renyin an edict said: "Marriage is the beginning of human relations.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict said: "Marriage is the beginning of human relations.

sentences.zh: 比者以來，貴族之門多不率法，或貪利財賂，或因緣私好，在於茍合，無所擇選。

translations.literal: In recent times the gates of the noble for the most part do not follow the law, some greedy for wealth and bribes, some joining through private favor, joining in hasty union without choosing.
translations.idiomatic: In recent times the gates of the noble for the most part do not follow the law, some greedy for wealth and bribes, some joining through private favor, joining in hasty union without choosing.

translations.idiomatic: They defile pure transformation and harm human relations—how shall We display the canonical models and hand them down to posterity?

translations.idiomatic: In spring of the sixth year, on bingshen in the first month, a great amnesty was proclaimed.

translations.literal: On the day dingchou in the second month he traveled in state to the Loufan Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the second month he traveled in state to the Loufan Palace.

translations.literal: Goguryeo, the Xiwang, Duiman, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goguryeo, the Xiwang, Duiman, and other states each sent envoys with tribute.

translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the third month Governor of Xiangzhou Prince of Xiping Commandery Tuyuhuan Quan died.

translations.idiomatic: On yisi the emperor returned to the palace.

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer the kingdom of Bactria presented sweat-blood horses and the kingdom of Pulan presented a precious sword.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the kingdom of Bactria presented sweat-blood horses and the kingdom of Pulan presented a precious sword.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，帝崩於太華殿，時年二十六。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the fifth month the Emperor died at the Taihua Hall, aged twenty-six.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the fifth month the emperor died at the Taihua Hall, aged twenty-six.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，奉尊謚曰文成皇帝，廟號高宗。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin in the sixth month the honored posthumous title Emperor Wencheng was granted; temple name Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the sixth month the honored posthumous title Emperor Wencheng was granted; temple name Gaozong.

sentences.zh: 八月，葬雲中之金陵。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he was buried at Jinling in Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he was buried at Jinling in Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 顯祖獻文皇帝諱弘，文成皇帝之長子也，母曰李貴人。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzu Xianwen, taboo name Hong, was the eldest son of Emperor Wencheng; his mother was Honored Lady Li.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzu Xianwen, taboo name Hong, was the eldest son of Emperor Wencheng; his mother was Honored Lady Li.

sentences.zh: 興光元年七月生於陰山之北。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Xingguang he was born north of Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Xingguang year one he was born north of Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 太安二年二月，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Tai'an he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tai'an year two he was installed as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 和平六年五月甲辰，即皇帝位，大赦。

translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the fifth month of Heping year six he took the imperial throne; a great amnesty was proclaimed.

translations.idiomatic: The empress was honored as empress dowager.

translations.literal: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry Yi Hun forged an edict and killed Director of the Masters of Writing Yang Baonian, Duke of Pingyang Jia Airen, and Duke of Nanyang Zhang Tiandu in the inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry Yi Hun forged an edict and killed Director of the Masters of Writing Yang Baonian, Duke of Pingyang Jia Airen, and Duke of Nanyang Zhang Tiandu in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 戊申，司徒公、平原王陸麗自湯泉入朝，又殺之。

translations.literal: On the day wushen Duke of the State, Prince of Pingyuan Lu Li entered court from Tangquan and Hun also killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Duke of the State, Prince of Pingyuan Lu Li entered court from Tangquan and Hun also killed him.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以渾為太尉公，以錄尚書事、東安王劉尼為司徒公，以尚書左僕射和其奴為司空公。

translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Hun was made Grand Commandant; Duke of the State Prince of Dong'an Liu Ni, who held charge of Masters of Writing affairs, was made Minister of Education; Vice Director of the Masters of Writing He Qinu was made Minister of Works.

translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the seventh autumn month Grand Commandant Yi Hun was made Chancellor, ranking above all princes; great and small affairs were all decided by him.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，曲赦京師。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the ninth month a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the ninth month a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

translations.literal: On the day bingwu an edict said: "The former court, because provincial governors are close to kin, should set good assistants; therefore officials were ordered to promulgate the nine-article system, letting the prior administration select clerks to await later men.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu an edict said: "The former court, because provincial governors are close to kin, should set good assistants; therefore officials were ordered to promulgate the nine-article system, letting the prior administration select clerks to await later men.

sentences.zh: 然牧司舉非其人，愆於典度。

translations.literal: Yet the pastoral offices recommended unworthy men, violating canonical measure.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the pastoral offices recommended unworthy men, violating canonical measure.

sentences.zh: 今制刺史守宰到官之日，仰自舉人望忠信，以為選官，不論前政，共相平置。

translations.literal: Now it is decreed that when governors and magistrates reach their posts they shall themselves recommend men of repute and loyalty to serve as selection officials, without regard to the prior administration, jointly balancing appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Now it is decreed that when governors and magistrates reach their posts they shall themselves recommend men of repute and loyalty to serve as selection officials, without regard to the prior administration, jointly balancing appointments.

sentences.zh: 若簡任失所，以罔上論。

translations.literal: If selection and appointment miss the mark, they are judged for deceiving the throne."
translations.idiomatic: If selection and appointment miss the mark, they are judged for deceiving the throne."

sentences.zh: 」是月，宋義陽王劉昶自彭城來奔。

translations.idiomatic: That month Prince of Yiyang Liu Chang of Song came fleeing from Pengcheng.

translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month Prince of Yangping Xincheng, Zitui of Jingzhao, Xiaoxincheng of Jiyin, Tianci of Ruyin, and Yun of Rencheng entered court.

sentences.zh: 十一月，宋湘東王彧殺其主子業而自立。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Prince of Xiangdong Liu Yu of Song killed his lord Ziye and installed himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Prince of Xiangdong Liu Yu of Song killed his lord Ziye and installed himself.

sentences.zh: 天安元年春正月己丑朔，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tian'an, first month of spring, on the first day jichou, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Tian'an year one, on jichou, the first day of the first month, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，丞相、太原王乙渾謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the second month Chancellor Prince of Taiyuan Yi Hun plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the second month Chancellor Prince of Taiyuan Yi Hun plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以侍中元孔雀為濮陽王，侍中陸定國為東郡王。

translations.literal: On the day yihai Palace Attendant Yuan Kongque was made Prince of Puyang and Palace Attendant Lu Dingguo Prince of Dongjun.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Palace Attendant Yuan Kongque was made Prince of Puyang and Palace Attendant Lu Dingguo Prince of Dongjun.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，以隴西王源賀為太尉公。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the third month Duke of Longxi Yuan He was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the third month Duke of Longxi Yuan He was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，京宗文成皇帝神主佑於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou the spirit tablet of Emperor Wencheng of the imperial lineage was placed in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the spirit tablet of Emperor Wencheng of the imperial lineage was placed in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，帝幸道壇，親受符箓。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai the Emperor visited the Dao altar and personally received the talismans and registers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the emperor visited the Dao altar and personally received the talismans and registers.

sentences.zh: 曲赦京師。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital.

sentences.zh: 秋九月己酉，初立鄉學，郡置博士二人，助教二人，學生六十人。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou in the ninth month of autumn district schools were first established; each commandery set two erudites, two assistant instructors, and sixty students.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the ninth autumn month district schools were first established; each commandery set two erudites, two assistant instructors, and sixty students.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，皇弟安平王薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter the Emperor's younger brother Prince of Anping died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth winter month the emperor's younger brother Prince of Anping died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，州鎮十一旱，人饑，開倉振恤。

translations.literal: That year eleven provinces and garrisons suffered drought; the people were famished; granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: That year eleven provinces and garrisons suffered drought; the people were famished; granaries were opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月癸未，田於西山，親射武豹。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the second year, on the day guiwei, he hunted at the western mountains and personally shot martial leopards.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the second spring month of the second year he hunted at the western mountains and personally shot martial leopards.

sentences.zh: 三月，慕容白曜進圍東陽。

translations.literal: In the third month Murong Baiyao advanced to besiege Dongyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Murong Baiyao advanced to besiege Dongyang.

sentences.zh: 戊午，宋人來聘。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu envoys came from Song on a mission of courtesy.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day bingzi in the fourth month of summer there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the first day of the fourth summer month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，進南郡公李惠爵為王。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou Duke of Nanjun Li Hui was advanced in rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Duke of Nanjun Li Hui was advanced in rank to prince.

sentences.zh: 五月乙卯，田於崞山，遂幸繁畤。

translations.literal: On the day yimao in the fifth month he hunted at Mount Zhuo and then visited Fanchi.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the fifth month he hunted at Mount Zhuo and then visited Fanchi.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，以河南避地，曲赦京師殊死已下。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, because Henan was a place of refuge, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital for crimes below extraordinary death.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, because Henan was a place of refuge, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the capital for crimes below extraordinary death.

sentences.zh: 以昌黎王馮熙為太傅。

translations.literal: Prince of Changli Feng Xi was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Changli Feng Xi was made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 秋九月辛亥，封皇叔楨為南安王，長壽為城陽王，太洛為章武王，休為安定王。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the ninth month of autumn the Emperor's uncles Zhen, Wanshou, Tailuo, and Xiu were enfeoffed as princes of Nan'an, Chengyang, Zhangwu, and Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the ninth autumn month the emperor's uncles Zhen, Wanshou, Tailuo, and Xiu were enfeoffed as princes of Nan'an, Chengyang, Zhangwu, and Anding.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day guiyou in the tenth month of winter there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the first day of the tenth winter month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，田於冷泉。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou he hunted at Lengquan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he hunted at Lengquan.

sentences.zh: 十一月，州鎮二十七水旱，詔開倉振恤。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month twenty-seven provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought; an edict ordered granaries opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month twenty-seven provinces and garrisons suffered flood and drought; an edict ordered granaries opened for relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，詔曰：「頃張永敢拒王威，暴骨原隰。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the twelfth month an edict said: "Recently Zhang Yong dared resist the royal might; bones lie white on the plains and marshes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the twelfth month an edict said: "Recently Zhang Yong dared resist the royal might; bones lie white on the plains and marshes.

sentences.zh: 天下之人一也，其永軍殘廢之士，聽還江南。

translations.literal: The people of the realm are one; let the maimed soldiers of Yong's army be permitted to return south of the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the realm are one; let the maimed soldiers of Yong's army be permitted to return south of the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 露骸草莽者，敕州縣收瘞之。」

translations.literal: Those whose exposed bones lie in the wild grass—order the provinces and counties to gather and bury them."
translations.idiomatic: Those whose exposed bones lie in the wild grass—order the provinces and counties to gather and bury them."

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day dingyou in the tenth month of winter there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the first day of the tenth winter month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 是月，太宰、頓丘王李峻薨。

translations.literal: That month Grand Preceptor Prince of Dunqiu Li Jun died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Grand Preceptor Prince of Dunqiu Li Jun died.

sentences.zh: 十一月，進襄城公韓頹爵為王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Duke of Xiangcheng Han Tui was advanced in rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Duke of Xiangcheng Han Tui was advanced in rank to prince.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，行幸河西。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei in the sixth month he traveled in state to Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the sixth month he traveled in state to Hexi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅，遂至陰山。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin in the seventh month of autumn he then reached Yinshan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the seventh autumn month he then reached Yinshan.

sentences.zh: 八月丁亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the eighth month the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the eighth month the emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 帝幼而神武，聰睿機悟，有濟人之規。

translations.literal: As a child he was divinely martial, keen and perceptive in stratagem, with a plan to aid others.
translations.idiomatic: As a child he was divinely martial, keen and perceptive in stratagem, with a plan to aid others.

sentences.zh: 仁孝純至，禮敬師友。

translations.literal: Pure in benevolence and filial piety, he ritually honored teachers and friends.
translations.idiomatic: Pure in benevolence and filial piety, he ritually honored teachers and friends.

sentences.zh: 及即位，雅薄時務，常有遺世之心，欲禪位於叔父京兆王子推，群臣固請，乃止。

translations.literal: When he took the throne he by nature held worldly affairs lightly and often had a mind to leave the world; he wished to abdicate to his uncle Zitui of Jingzhao; the ministers firmly petitioned and he desisted.
translations.idiomatic: When he took the throne he by nature held worldly affairs lightly and often had a mind to leave the world; he wished to abdicate to his uncle Zitui of Jingzhao; the ministers firmly petitioned and he desisted.

sentences.zh: 丙午，使太保建安王陸珝、太尉源賀奉皇帝璽綬，冊命皇太子升帝位。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu he ordered Grand Guardian Prince of Jian'an Lu Yu and Grand Commandant Yuan He to present the imperial seal and cord and invest the crown prince with the imperial position.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he ordered Grand Guardian Prince of Jian'an Lu Yu and Grand Commandant Yuan He to present the imperial seal and cord and invest the crown prince with the imperial position.

sentences.zh: 於是群公奏上尊號太上皇帝。

translations.literal: Thereupon the assembled dukes submitted the honorific title Emperor Emeritus.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the assembled dukes submitted the honorific title Emperor Emeritus.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太上皇帝徙御崇光宮，采椽不斫，土階而已。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou the Emperor Emeritus moved his residence to Chongguang Palace; rafters were unhewn and the steps were of earth alone.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the Emperor Emeritus moved his residence to Chongguang Palace; rafters were unhewn and the steps were of earth alone.

sentences.zh: 國之大事咸以聞。

translations.literal: Great affairs of state were all reported to him.
translations.idiomatic: Great affairs of state were all reported to him.

sentences.zh: 承明元年，文明太后有憾，帝崩於永安殿，年二十三。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chengming the Civilized Empress Dowager bore resentment; the Emperor died at Yong'an Palace, aged twenty-three.
translations.idiomatic: In Chengming year one the Civilized Empress Dowager bore resentment; the emperor died at Yong'an Palace, aged twenty-three.

sentences.zh: 上尊謚曰獻文皇帝，廟號顯祖。

translations.literal: The honored posthumous title Emperor Xianwen was granted; temple name Xianzu.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted the posthumous title Emperor Xianwen; his temple name was Xianzu.

sentences.zh: 葬雲中金陵。

translations.literal: He was buried at Jinling in Yunzhong.
translations.idiomatic: His burial was at Jinling in Yunzhong.

sentences.zh: 論曰：太武聰明雄斷，威靈傑立。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Taiwu was intelligent, resolute, and heroic; his majesty and spirit stood forth as outstanding.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Emperor Taiwu was quick-witted and fiercely decisive, his authority and presence towering above the rest.

sentences.zh: 藉二世之資，奮征伐之氣，遂戎軒四出，周旋夷險。

translations.literal: Relying on the resources of two reigns, he roused the spirit of conquest and campaign; his war chariots went forth on four sides, turning through hardship and peril.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on the resources of two reigns, he roused the spirit of conquest; his war chariots went forth on four sides, turning through hardship and peril.

sentences.zh: 平秦、隴，掃統萬，翦遼海，蕩河源。

translations.literal: He pacified Qin and Long, swept Tongwan, cut through Liaohai, and cleared the source of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified Qin and Long, swept Tongwan, cut through Liaohai, and cleared the source of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 南夷荷擔，北蠕絕跡，廓定四表，混一華戎。

translations.literal: The southern barbarians bore burdens on their backs; the northern Rouran vanished without trace; he defined the four quarters and united Chinese and barbarian.
translations.idiomatic: The southern barbarians bore burdens on their backs; the northern Rouran vanished without trace; he defined the four quarters and united Chinese and barbarian.

sentences.zh: 其為武功也大矣。

translations.literal: How great were his martial achievements!
translations.idiomatic: His military achievement was vast indeed.

sentences.zh: 遂使有魏之業，光邁百王。

translations.literal: Thus the enterprise of Wei shone beyond the hundred kings.
translations.idiomatic: Thus did the house of Wei outshine the hundred kings of old.

sentences.zh: 豈非神睿經綸，事當命世。

translations.literal: Was it not divine wisdom and statecraft, affairs fitting an age that received the mandate?
translations.idiomatic: Surely this was divine wisdom in ordering the realm, the work of one born for his age.

sentences.zh: 至於初則東儲不終，末乃釁成所忽，固本貽防，殆弗思乎。

translations.literal: As for the beginning, the eastern heir did not reach his end; at the last, trouble arose from what was neglected—did he not think to strengthen the root and guard against harm?
translations.idiomatic: As for the beginning, the eastern heir did not reach his end; at the last, trouble arose from what was neglected—did he not think to strengthen the root and guard against harm?

sentences.zh: 景穆明德令聞，夙世殂夭，其戾園之悼歟。

translations.literal: Jingmu had bright virtue and a fine reputation yet died young in his generation—is this not the grief of the Liyuan?
translations.idiomatic: Jingmu had bright virtue and a fine reputation yet died young in his generation—is this not the grief of the Liyuan?

sentences.zh: 文成屬太武之後，內頗虛耗，既而國釁時艱，朝野楚楚。

translations.literal: Wencheng belonged to the line after Taiwu; within, depletion was quite evident; soon national peril and timely hardship arose, and court and countryside were in distress.
translations.idiomatic: Wencheng belonged to the line after Taiwu; within, depletion was quite evident; soon national peril and timely hardship arose, and court and countryside were in distress.

sentences.zh: 帝與時消息，靜以鎮之。

translations.literal: The Emperor responded to the times and kept still, using calm to settle them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor responded to the times and kept still, using calm to settle them.

sentences.zh: 養威布德，懷緝中外，自非機悟深裕，矜濟為心，亦何能若此？

translations.literal: He nurtured might and spread virtue, cherishing and binding within and without—had he not been deeply perceptive in stratagem and magnanimous in succoring others, how could he have done thus?
translations.idiomatic: He nurtured might and spread virtue, cherishing and binding within and without—had he not been deeply perceptive in stratagem and magnanimous in succoring others, how could he have done thus?

sentences.zh: 可謂有君人之度矣。

translations.literal: One may say he had the measure of a true ruler.
translations.idiomatic: It may be said that he possessed the stature of a true sovereign.

sentences.zh: 獻文聰睿夙成，兼資雄斷，故能更清漠野，大啟南服。

translations.literal: Xianwen was keen and perceptive from youth, combining heroic decisiveness; therefore he could further clear the desert wilds and greatly open the southern domains.
translations.idiomatic: Xianwen was keen and perceptive from youth, combining heroic decisiveness; therefore he could further clear the desert wilds and greatly open the southern domains.

sentences.zh: 而早有厭世之心，終致宮闈之變，將天意也。

translations.literal: Yet he early bore a mind weary of the world and in the end brought palace turmoil—is this not Heaven's intent?
translations.idiomatic: Yet he early bore a mind weary of the world and in the end brought palace turmoil—is this not Heaven's intent?
